--[[ KSC LAUNCHER — KSC Hub / KSC Public Hub / KSC DUEL | cleaned ]]
local function KSC_LauncherMain(SRC_KSC, SRC_PUBLIC, SRC_DUEL)
    local Players      = game:GetService("Players")
    local UIS          = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local RunService   = game:GetService("RunService")
    local HttpService  = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local CoreGui      = game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local LP           = Players.LocalPlayer

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Config (auto-exécute) sauvegardée sur le disque
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local CFG_FILE = "KscLauncher.json"
    local cfg = { auto = false, choice = "" }
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and readfile and isfile(CFG_FILE) then
            local d = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CFG_FILE))
            if type(d) == "table" then
                cfg.auto = (d.auto == true)
                cfg.choice = tostring(d.choice or "")
            end
        end
    end)
    local function saveCfg()
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then writefile(CFG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(cfg)) end
        end)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Palette KSC
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local C = {
        Bg      = Color3.fromRGB(18, 19, 25),
        Deep    = Color3.fromRGB(13, 14, 19),
        Card    = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 38),
        CardHi  = Color3.fromRGB(38, 39, 49),
        Pink    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147),
        PinkLt  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 180),
        Text    = Color3.fromRGB(242, 243, 247),
        Dim     = Color3.fromRGB(165, 168, 180),
        Off     = Color3.fromRGB(38, 39, 49),
        Yellow  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0),
        YellowLt = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 110),
    }

    local function parentGui()
        local ok, h = pcall(function() return gethui and gethui() end)
        if ok and h then return h end
        return CoreGui
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Fermer l'interface d'un hub déjà lancé
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local HUB_GUIS = {
        KscHub = true, NoxHub = true, FluxHub = true, SemiTP = true,
        SemiTPStats = true, StealProgressScreenGui = true, BJKHub_V3 = true,
        AuroraHub = true, BJKHub = true,
        -- KscHubReopen intentionally NOT listed: must stay for open/close
    }
    local function closeHubs()
        local parents = {}
        pcall(function() parents[#parents + 1] = CoreGui end)
        pcall(function() if gethui then parents[#parents + 1] = gethui() end end)
        pcall(function()
            local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if pg then parents[#parents + 1] = pg end
        end)
        for _, par in ipairs(parents) do
            pcall(function()
                for _, g in ipairs(par:GetChildren()) do
                    if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and (HUB_GUIS[g.Name] or g.Name:sub(1, 9) == "PanelGui_") then
                        pcall(function() g:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        pcall(function() if _G._FH_KSC_GUI then _G._FH_KSC_GUI:Destroy() end end)
    end

    local showMenu

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Bouton persistant pour rouvrir le launcher
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local function hideReopenButton()
        pcall(function()
            local g = _G.KSC_LauncherReopenGui
            if g then g.Enabled = false end
        end)
    end

    local function showReopenButton()
        local pg = parentGui()
        local g = _G.KSC_LauncherReopenGui
        if not g or not g.Parent then
            g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            g.Name = "KscLauncherReopen"
            g.ResetOnSpawn = false
            g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            g.DisplayOrder = 2147483646
            g.Parent = pg
            _G.KSC_LauncherReopenGui = g

            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Name = "KscLauncherReopenButton"
            b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 34)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 80)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = C.Pink
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.Text = "KSC LAUNCHER"
            b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            b.TextSize = 11
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.Active = true
            b.ZIndex = 100
            b.Parent = g
            local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
            c.Parent = b
            local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            st.Color = C.PinkLt
            st.Thickness = 1.5
            st.Transparency = 0.2
            st.Parent = b
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                g.Enabled = false
                showMenu()
            end)
        end
        g.Enabled = true
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Lancer un hub
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local function runHub(key)
        local isPublic = (key == "public")
        local isDuel = (key == "duel")
        local src = isDuel and SRC_DUEL or (isPublic and SRC_PUBLIC or SRC_KSC)
        local label = isDuel and "KSC_DUEL" or (isPublic and "KSC_Public_Hub" or "KSC_Hub")
        local fn, err = loadstring(src, "=" .. label)
        if not fn then
            warn("[KSC Launcher] " .. label .. " compile error: " .. tostring(err))
            return false
        end
        _G.KSC_ActiveHub = key
        cfg.choice = key
        saveCfg()
        hideReopenButton()
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, e = pcall(fn)
            if not ok then warn("[KSC Launcher] " .. label .. " error: " .. tostring(e)) end
            -- after hub loads, force-flush its config if present
            task.delay(1.5, function()
                pcall(function()
                    if Config and Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                    if _G.KscHubConfig and _G.KscHubConfig.flush then _G.KscHubConfig.flush() end
                    if _G.NoxHubConfig and _G.NoxHubConfig.flush then _G.NoxHubConfig.flush() end
                end)
            end)
            showReopenButton()
        end)
        return true
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Interface : deux blocs + Auto-Execute au milieu en dessous
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    function showMenu()
        pcall(function() if _G.KSC_LauncherGui then _G.KSC_LauncherGui:Destroy() end end)

        local conns = {}
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "KscLauncher"
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        gui.DisplayOrder = 2147483000
        gui.Parent = parentGui()
        _G.KSC_LauncherGui = gui
        gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        end)

        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
        local W = math.clamp(vp.X - 24, 300, 640)
        local H = math.clamp(vp.Y - 24, 236, 320)

        local dim = Instance.new("Frame")
        dim.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        dim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        dim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
        dim.BorderSizePixel = 0
        dim.Active = false
        dim.Parent = gui

        local win = Instance.new("Frame")
        win.Size = UDim2.new(0, W, 0, H)
        win.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        win.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        win.BackgroundColor3 = C.Bg
        win.BorderSizePixel = 0
        win.Active = true
        win.Parent = gui
        local wc = Instance.new("UICorner"); wc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16); wc.Parent = win

        local gradients = {}
        local function animStroke(parent, thickness)
            local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            st.Thickness = thickness
            st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            st.Parent = parent
            local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, C.Pink),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 215)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C.Pink),
            })
            g.Parent = st
            gradients[#gradients + 1] = g
            return st
        end
        animStroke(win, 2)

        local rot = 0
        conns[#conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            rot = (rot + dt * 90) % 360
            for _, g in ipairs(gradients) do
                if g.Parent then g.Rotation = rot end
            end
        end)

        -- Barre de titre (déplaçable)
        local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
        bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
        bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        bar.Parent = win

        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
        title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Text = "KSC LAUNCHER"
        title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        title.TextSize = 16
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.Parent = bar
        local tg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        tg.Color = ColorSequence.new(C.Pink, C.PinkLt)
        tg.Parent = title

        local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
        closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 6)
        closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.Card
        closeBtn.Text = "X"
        closeBtn.TextColor3 = C.Text
        closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        closeBtn.TextSize = 13
        closeBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        closeBtn.Parent = bar
        local cc = Instance.new("UICorner"); cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8); cc.Parent = closeBtn
        
    -- Minimize launcher (-): hides the launcher window, shows reopen pill
    local minimizeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minimizeBtn.Name = "KSC_Launcher_Minimize"
    minimizeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
    minimizeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0, 6)
    minimizeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.Card
    minimizeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    minimizeBtn.Text = "-"
    minimizeBtn.TextColor3 = C.Text
    minimizeBtn.TextSize = 20
    minimizeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    minimizeBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    minimizeBtn.ZIndex = 50
    minimizeBtn.Parent = bar
    do
        local mc = Instance.new("UICorner")
        mc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        mc.Parent = minimizeBtn
    end
    local function doMinimizeLauncher()
        pcall(function() gui.Enabled = false end)
        pcall(showReopenButton)
    end
    minimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doMinimizeLauncher)
    minimizeBtn.Activated:Connect(doMinimizeLauncher)
    minimizeBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            doMinimizeLauncher()
        end
    end)

local closingLauncher = false
local function closeLauncher()
    if closingLauncher then return end
    closingLauncher = true
    pcall(function()
        if _G.KSC_LauncherReopenGui then
            _G.KSC_LauncherReopenGui:Destroy()
            _G.KSC_LauncherReopenGui = nil
        end
    end)
    pcall(function() gui.Enabled = false end)
    pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
    _G.KSC_LauncherGui = nil
end
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeLauncher)
closeBtn.Activated:Connect(closeLauncher)
closeBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        closeLauncher()
    end
end)

        local dragging, dragStart, winStart = false, nil, nil
        bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = inp.Position
                winStart = win.Position
            end
        end)
        conns[#conns + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if dragging and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local d = inp.Position - dragStart
                win.Position = UDim2.new(winStart.X.Scale, winStart.X.Offset + d.X, winStart.Y.Scale, winStart.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end)
        conns[#conns + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)

        -- Les deux blocs
        local PAD = 14
        local blockW = (W - PAD * 4) / 3
        local blockH = H - 40 - 58 - 6
        local badges = {}

        local function choose(key)
            cfg.choice = key
            saveCfg()
            gui:Destroy()
            runHub(key)
        end

        local function makeBlock(idx, key, name, sub, accent, accentLt)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Name = "Block_" .. key
            b.Size = UDim2.new(0, blockW, 0, blockH)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(0, PAD + (idx - 1) * (blockW + PAD), 0, 44)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = C.Card
            b.Text = ""
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.Parent = win
            local bc = Instance.new("UICorner"); bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14); bc.Parent = b
            local st = animStroke(b, 1.5)
            st.Transparency = 0.45

            local glow = Instance.new("Frame")
            glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
            glow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            glow.BackgroundColor3 = accent or C.Pink
            glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
            glow.Parent = b
            local gcor = Instance.new("UICorner"); gcor.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14); gcor.Parent = glow

            local n = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            n.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 40)
            n.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -34)
            n.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            n.Text = name
            n.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            n.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            n.TextScaled = true
            n.Parent = b
            local nc = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint"); nc.MaxTextSize = 24; nc.MinTextSize = 10; nc.Parent = n
            local ng = Instance.new("UIGradient"); ng.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent or C.Pink, accentLt or C.PinkLt); ng.Parent = n

            local s = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            s.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16)
            s.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 8)
            s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            s.Text = sub
            s.TextColor3 = C.Dim
            s.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            s.TextSize = 11
            s.Parent = b

            local go = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            go.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 26)
            go.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -36)
            go.BackgroundColor3 = accent or C.Pink
            go.Text = "LAUNCH"
            go.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            go.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            go.TextSize = 12
            go.Parent = b
            local goc = Instance.new("UICorner"); goc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8); goc.Parent = go

            local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            badge.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 16)
            badge.Position = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0, 10)
            badge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
            badge.Text = "AUTO"
            badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 19, 25)
            badge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            badge.TextSize = 9
            badge.Visible = false
            badge.Parent = b
            local bgc = Instance.new("UICorner"); bgc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6); bgc.Parent = badge
            badges[key] = badge

            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                pcall(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundColor3 = C.CardHi }):Play() end)
                pcall(function() TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Transparency = 0 }):Play() end)
            end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                pcall(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { BackgroundColor3 = C.Card }):Play() end)
                pcall(function() TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.12), { Transparency = 0.45 }):Play() end)
            end)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() choose(key) end)
        end

        makeBlock(1, "ksc", "KSC Hub", "Private build", C.Yellow, C.PinkLt)
        makeBlock(2, "public", "KSC Public Hub", "Public build", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147))
        makeBlock(3, "duel", "KSC DUEL", "Duel build", C.Yellow, C.PinkLt)

        -- Bouton Auto-Execute (centré, sous les deux blocs)
        local autoBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        autoBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 36)
        autoBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        autoBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -48)
        autoBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.Card
        autoBtn.Text = ""
        autoBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        autoBtn.Parent = win
        local ac = Instance.new("UICorner"); ac.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10); ac.Parent = autoBtn
        local ast = Instance.new("UIStroke"); ast.Color = C.PinkLt; ast.Transparency = 0.5; ast.Thickness = 1; ast.Parent = autoBtn

        local al = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        al.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0)
        al.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
        al.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        al.Text = "Auto-Execute"
        al.TextColor3 = C.Text
        al.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        al.TextSize = 13
        al.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        al.Parent = autoBtn

        local track = Instance.new("Frame")
        track.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 22)
        track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0.5, -11)
        track.BackgroundColor3 = C.Off
        track.BorderSizePixel = 0
        track.Parent = autoBtn
        local trc = Instance.new("UICorner"); trc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); trc.Parent = track
        local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
        knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8)
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        knob.Parent = track
        local kc = Instance.new("UICorner"); kc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0); kc.Parent = knob

        local function refreshAuto()
            pcall(function()
                TweenService:Create(track, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { BackgroundColor3 = cfg.auto and C.Pink or C.Off }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(knob, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Position = cfg.auto and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, -8) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8) }):Play()
            end)
            for key, badge in pairs(badges) do
                badge.Visible = (cfg.auto and cfg.choice == key)
            end
        end
        autoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            cfg.auto = not cfg.auto
            saveCfg()
            refreshAuto()
        end)
        refreshAuto()
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- API globale : les boutons "Open Launcher" des hubs l'appellent
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    _G.KSC_OpenLauncher = function()
        closeHubs()
        showMenu()
    end

    -- Auto-exécute : lance directement le hub choisi, sans afficher l'interface
    if cfg.auto and (cfg.choice == "ksc" or cfg.choice == "public" or cfg.choice == "duel") then
        runHub(cfg.choice)
    else
        showMenu()
    end
end


KSC_LauncherMain(
[=[

--[[ KSC HUB — by ksc & kscz ]]
print("[KSC-HUB] loading...")

local function _try(fn, ...)
    local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
    return ok, err
end

_try(function() if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(8) end end)
_try(function() if setidentity then setidentity(8) end end)
_try(function() if set_thread_identity then set_thread_identity(8) end end)
_try(function() if syn and syn.set_thread_identity then syn.set_thread_identity(8) end end)
_try(function() if setthreadcontext then setthreadcontext(8) end end)
_try(function() if setcontext then setcontext(8) end end)
_try(function() if set_thread_capability then set_thread_capability("Plugin") end end)
_try(function() if setthreadcapability then setthreadcapability("Plugin") end end)

if type(cloneref) ~= "function" then
    local _cr = rawget(getfenv(), "cloneref")
        or rawget(getfenv(), "clonereference")
        or (syn and syn.cloneref)
        or (getrenv and getrenv().cloneref)
    if type(_cr) == "function" then
        cloneref = _cr
    else
        cloneref = function(o) return o end
    end
end

do
    local _origGetService = game.GetService
    local _safeGetService = function(self, name)
        local ok, svc = pcall(_origGetService, self, name)
        if ok then return svc end
        task.wait()
        return _origGetService(self, name)
    end
    _G.__SafeGetService = _safeGetService
end

pcall(function()
    if type(setfpscap) == "function" then
        setfpscap(9999)
    end
end)

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Patch PlotClient / NumberUtils nil errors
-- NumberUtils.ToString → math.abs(nil)  |  UpdateClaim mul on nil
----------------------------------------------------------------
pcall(function()
    local _abs = math.abs
    math.abs = function(x)
        if type(x) ~= "number" then
            x = tonumber(x)
        end
        if type(x) ~= "number" then
            return 0
        end
        return _abs(x)
    end
end)

pcall(function()
    local function patchNumberUtils(mod)
        if type(mod) ~= "table" then return end
        for _, key in ipairs({ "ToString", "toString", "Format", "format", "Abbreviate", "abbreviate" }) do
            local fn = mod[key]
            if type(fn) == "function" then
                mod[key] = function(n, ...)
                    if n == nil then n = 0 end
                    if type(n) ~= "number" then
                        n = tonumber(n) or 0
                    end
                    return fn(n, ...)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local utils = rs:FindFirstChild("Utils")
    local nu = utils and utils:FindFirstChild("NumberUtils")
    if nu then
        local ok, mod = pcall(require, nu)
        if ok then patchNumberUtils(mod) end
    end
    -- also try Packages path variants
    pcall(function()
        local ok, mod = pcall(function()
            return require(rs:WaitForChild("Utils"):WaitForChild("NumberUtils"))
        end)
        if ok then patchNumberUtils(mod) end
    end)
end)

-- Soft-sanitize Claim values so PlotClient UpdateClaim does not mul nil
pcall(function()
    local function sanitizeClaim(inst)
        if not inst then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, attr in ipairs({
                "Generation", "generation", "Income", "Gen",
                "BaseGeneration", "BaseIncome", "Claim", "Money",
                "Rate", "Multiplier", "Offline", "Time",
            }) do
                local ok, v = pcall(function() return inst:GetAttribute(attr) end)
                if ok and v == nil then
                    -- leave unset
                elseif ok and type(v) ~= "number" and v ~= nil then
                    local n = tonumber(v)
                    if n then
                        pcall(function() inst:SetAttribute(attr, n) end)
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, ch in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("NumberValue") or ch:IsA("IntValue") or ch:IsA("NumberConstraint") then
                    if ch.Value == nil then
                        pcall(function() ch.Value = 0 end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function scanPlots()
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            if pods then
                for _, pod in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                    local claim = pod:FindFirstChild("Claim")
                    if claim then sanitizeClaim(claim) end
                    sanitizeClaim(pod)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        for _ = 1, 8 do
            task.wait(0.5)
            pcall(scanPlots)
        end
        -- light periodic pass (cheap)
        while not rawget(_G, "_FH_SHUTDOWN") do
            task.wait(5)
            pcall(scanPlots)
        end
    end)
end)

local _cloneref_safe = (type(cloneref) == "function") and cloneref or function(o) return o end
Services = setmetatable({}, {
    __index = function(self, name)
        local success, cache = pcall(function()
            return _cloneref_safe(game:GetService(name))
        end)
        if success then
            rawset(self, name, cache)
            return cache
        else
            error("Invalid Service: " .. tostring(name))
        end
    end
})

        if _G._FH_SHUTDOWN then return true end
        if _GEN ~= _G._FH_NOX_GEN then return true end
        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
        if not lp or lp.Parent == nil then return true end
        return false
    end

    local function _doTeardown()
        if _G._FH_SHUTDOWN_DONE then return end

        _G._FH_SHUTDOWN = true

            pcall(fn)
        end
    end

        Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)

    -- Contrast knob color: primary==secondary → white; both white → black
    local function _NoxKnobOnColor()
        local p = Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147)
        local s = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        pcall(function()
            if Theme and typeof(Theme.c1) == "Color3" then p = Theme.c1 end
            if T and typeof(T.White) == "Color3" then s = T.White end
            if typeof(_G.coreTheme) == "table" then
                if typeof(_G.coreTheme.primary) == "Color3" then p = _G.coreTheme.primary end
                if typeof(_G.coreTheme.secondary) == "Color3" then s = _G.coreTheme.secondary end
            end
        end)
        local function nearWhite(c)
            return c.R > 0.92 and c.G > 0.92 and c.B > 0.92
        end
        local function near(a, b)
            return math.abs(a.R - b.R) < 0.04 and math.abs(a.G - b.G) < 0.04 and math.abs(a.B - b.B) < 0.04
        end
        if nearWhite(p) and nearWhite(s) then
            return Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16)
        end
        if near(p, s) then
            return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        end
        return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
    _G._NoxKnobOnColor = _NoxKnobOnColor

        end
    end

    local function SetGuiColor(col)
        local _h, _s, _v = Color3.toHSV(col)
        T.Bg         = Color3.fromHSV(_h, _s,           _v)
        T.BgDeep     = Color3.fromHSV(_h, _s,           math.max(_v * 0.65, 0))
        T.Side       = Color3.fromHSV(_h, _s * 0.9,     math.min(_v * 1.35, 1))
        T.SideHover  = Color3.fromHSV(_h, _s * 0.75,    math.min(_v * 1.90, 1))
        T.SideActive = Color3.fromHSV(_h, _s * 0.75,    math.min(_v * 1.90, 1))
        T.Card       = Color3.fromHSV(_h, _s * 0.85,    math.min(_v * 1.60, 1))
        T.CardHover  = Color3.fromHSV(_h, _s * 0.75,    math.min(_v * 2.00, 1))
        T.Line       = Color3.fromHSV(_h, _s * 0.55,    math.min(_v * 2.80, 0.45))
        T.Soft       = Color3.fromHSV(_h, _s * 0.80,    math.min(_v * 1.70, 1))
        RepaintBgs()
        pcall(function()
            if Dot2 then Dot2.BackgroundColor3 = T.Bg end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(_G._NoxBroadcastTheme) == "function" then
                _G._NoxBroadcastTheme()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function SetAccentColor(col)
        Theme.c1 = col
        T.Primary = col
        T.Green = col
        local _h, _s, _v = Color3.toHSV(col)
        Theme.c2 = Color3.fromHSV(_h, math.clamp(_s * 0.75, 0, 1), math.max(_v * 0.32, 0.08))
        pcall(function()
            if Dot1 then Dot1.BackgroundColor3 = col end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if typeof(PageTitle) == "Instance" then PageTitle.TextColor3 = col end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if _G._FH_ReopenBtn then
                _G._FH_ReopenBtn.BackgroundColor3 = col
                local lum = 0.299 * col.R + 0.587 * col.G + 0.114 * col.B
                _G._FH_ReopenBtn.TextColor3 = (lum > 0.55) and Color3.fromRGB(12, 6, 22) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            end
        end)
        if type(Repaint) == "function" then
            pcall(Repaint)
        end
        pcall(function()
            if Root then
                for _, d in ipairs(Root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d.Name == "LogoBadge" or d.Name == "LogoBox" then
                        d.BackgroundColor3 = col
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(_G._NoxBroadcastTheme) == "function" then
                _G._NoxBroadcastTheme()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function themeSeq()
        local pink = Theme.c1 or Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147)
        local yellow = Theme.c2 or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
        -- half pink / half yellow, soft blend where they meet
        local mid = Color3.new(
            (pink.R + yellow.R) * 0.5,
            (pink.G + yellow.G) * 0.5,
            (pink.B + yellow.B) * 0.5
        )
        return ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,    pink),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.42, pink),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,  mid),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, yellow),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,    yellow),
        })
    end

    local function trackSolid(frame, slot)
        table.insert(ThemeSolids, {frame = frame, slot = slot})
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = (slot == 1) and Theme.c1 or Theme.c2
    end

    local function Tween(o, i, p)
        TweenService:Create(o, i, p):Play()
    end

    local function Corner(p, r)
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.min(r or 12, 7))
        c.Parent = p
        return c
    end

    local function Stroke(p, col, th, trans)
        local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        s.Color           = col or T.Line
        s.Thickness       = th or 1
        s.Transparency    = trans or 0
        s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        s.Parent          = p
        return s
    end

    local function Pad(p, t, b, l, r)
        local u = Instance.new("UIPadding")
        u.PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, t or 0)
        u.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, b or 0)
        u.PaddingLeft   = UDim.new(0, l or 0)
        u.PaddingRight  = UDim.new(0, r or 0)
        u.Parent = p
    end

    local function Grad(p, _c1, _c2, rot)
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        g.Color    = themeSeq()
        g.Rotation = rot or 0
        g.Parent   = p
        table.insert(ThemeGrads, {grad = g, baseRot = rot or 0, speed = 1})
        return g
    end

    local function GradStroke(p, th, trans, rot)
        local s = Stroke(p, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), th or 1.8, trans or 0.05)
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        g.Color = themeSeq()
        g.Rotation = rot or 90
        g.Parent = s
        table.insert(ThemeGrads, {grad = g, baseRot = rot or 90, speed = 1})
        return s
    end

    Repaint = function()
        local seq = themeSeq()
        for _, e in ipairs(ThemeGrads) do
            if e.grad and e.grad.Parent then
                pcall(function() e.grad.Color = seq end)
            end
        end
        for _, e in ipairs(ThemeSolids) do

                pcall(function()
                    e.frame.BackgroundColor3 = (e.slot == 1) and Theme.c1 or Theme.c2
                end)
            end

                PageTitle.TextColor3 = Theme.c1
            end
        end)
        T.Primary = Theme.c1
        T.Green = Theme.c1
    end

    -- KSC HUB logo (embedded) — replaces purple side squares
    local NOX_SIDE_IMAGE_FALLBACK = "rbxassetid://122136004623357"
    local NOX_SIDE_IMAGE = NOX_SIDE_IMAGE_FALLBACK
    local _NoxLogoB64 = ""
    local function _NoxEnsureLogoAsset()
        local path = "KscHub/nox_logo.png"
        pcall(function()
            if makefolder and not (isfolder and isfolder("NoxHub")) then
                makefolder("NoxHub")
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if writefile and (not isfile or not isfile(path)) then
                local ok, data = pcall(function()
                    return game:GetService("HttpService"):Base64Decode(_NoxLogoB64)
                end)
                if not ok or type(data) ~= "string" then
                    -- manual base64 decode fallback
                    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
                    local function dec(data)
                        data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
                        return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
                            if x == '=' then return '' end
                            local r, f = '', (b:find(x)-1)
                            for i = 6, 1, -1 do
                                r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i-1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
                            end
                            return r
                        end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
                            if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
                            local c = 0
                            for i = 1, 8 do
                                c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8-i) or 0)
                            end
                            return string.char(c)
                        end))
                    end
                    data = dec(_NoxLogoB64)
                end
                if type(data) == "string" and #data > 100 then
                    writefile(path, data)
                end
            end
        end)
        local asset = nil
        pcall(function()
            if type(getcustomasset) == "function" and isfile and isfile(path) then
                asset = getcustomasset(path)
            end
        end)
        if type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
            NOX_SIDE_IMAGE = asset
            return asset
        end
        NOX_SIDE_IMAGE = NOX_SIDE_IMAGE_FALLBACK
        return NOX_SIDE_IMAGE
    end
    pcall(_NoxEnsureLogoAsset)
   local _NoxSideImageBoxes = {}
local function _NoxAttachSideImage(panel, titleBar)
	if not panel or not panel.Parent then return end
	pcall(function()
		local imgAsset = _NoxEnsureLogoAsset()
		
		-- Liste des panneaux où l'on NE veut PAS le logo (Admin Spammer, Steal Target, Actions, Defense, Command Cooldowns)
		local SKIP_SIDE = {
			["PanelGui_NoxQuickPanel"] = true,
			["PanelGui_FluxQuickPanel"] = true,
			["PanelGui_Booster"] = true,
			["PanelGui_Instant Steal"] = true,
			["PanelGui_Instant Steal V2"] = true,
			["PanelGui_Admin Panel"] = true, 
			["KscHubBanner"] = true,
			
			-- AJOUT DES PANNEAUX DEMANDÉS :
			["PanelGui_Nox Admin Spammer"] = true, -- Admin Spammer
			["PanelGui_StealTarget"] = true,       -- Steal Target
			["PanelGui_Actions"] = true,           -- Actions
			["PanelGui_ActionsMobile"] = true,     -- Actions Mobile
			["PanelGui_Nox Defense"] = true,       -- Defense
			["PanelGui_Defense"] = true,           -- Defense (variante nom)
			["PanelGui_Command Cooldowns"] = true, -- Command Cooldowns
		}

		local function isSkipped(inst)
			local cur = inst
			while cur do
				if SKIP_SIDE[cur.Name] then return true end
				cur = cur.Parent
			end
			return false
		end

		if isSkipped(panel) or (titleBar and isSkipped(titleBar)) then
			for _, root in ipairs({panel, titleBar}) do
				if root then
					local ex = root:FindFirstChild("NoxSideImage", true)
					if ex then pcall(function() ex:Destroy() end) end
				end
			end
			return
		end

		local host = titleBar
		if not host or not host.Parent then
			host = panel:FindFirstChild("TitleBar")
			or panel:FindFirstChild("Header")
			or panel:FindFirstChild("CDHdr")
			or panel
		end
		if not host then return end

		local old = host:FindFirstChild("NoxSideImage") or panel:FindFirstChild("NoxSideImage")
		if old then
			if old:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				old.Image = imgAsset
				old.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			elseif old:IsA("Frame") then
				old.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				local ic = old:FindFirstChild("Icon")
				if ic and ic:IsA("ImageLabel") then
					ic.Image = imgAsset
					ic.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				end
			end
			return
		end

		local size = 26
		if host == panel then
			size = 32
		end

		-- Transparent host frame (no purple square)
		local box = Instance.new("Frame")
		box.Name = "NoxSideImage"
		box.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
		box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
		if host == panel then
			box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
			box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		else
			box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0)
		end
		box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		box.BorderSizePixel = 0
		local baseZ = math.max(host.ZIndex or 1, panel.ZIndex or 1)
		box.ZIndex = baseZ + 50
		box.Parent = host

		local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		img.Name = "Icon"
		img.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		img.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		img.Image = imgAsset
		img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		img.ZIndex = box.ZIndex + 1
		img.Parent = box

		local ic = Instance.new("UICorner")
		ic.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		ic.Parent = img
		
		table.insert(_NoxSideImageBoxes, box)

		-- Shift title labels to the right so they don't overlap the square
		pcall(function()
			for _, d in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
				if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Name ~= "Icon" then
					local pos = d.Position
					local left = pos.X.Offset
					if left < size + 14 then
						d.Position = UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, size + 14, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset)
						if d.Size.X.Offset > 0 then
							d.Size = UDim2.new(d.Size.X.Scale, math.max(40, d.Size.X.Offset - (size + 4)), d.Size.Y.Scale, d.Size.Y.Offset)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end)
end
_G._NoxAttachSideImage = _NoxAttachSideImage

    local function _NoxStyleLikeHub(panel, titleBar)
        if not panel or not panel.Parent then return end
        pcall(function()
            panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.Bg
            panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.02
            panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
        end)
        pcall(function() trackBgFrame(panel, "Bg") end)

        pcall(function()
            local c = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
            if not c then
                c = Instance.new("UICorner")
                c.Parent = panel
            end
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
        end)

        pcall(function()
            for _, ch in ipairs(panel:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("UIStroke") and not ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") then
                    ch:Destroy()
                elseif ch:IsA("UIStroke") then
                    local g = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
                    if g then
                        g.Color = themeSeq()
                        g.Rotation = 90
                        table.insert(ThemeGrads, {grad = g, baseRot = 90, speed = 1})
                    end
                    ch.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    ch.Thickness = 1.8
                    ch.Transparency = 0.05
                end
            end
            if not panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") then
                GradStroke(panel, 1.6, 0.25, 90)
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            if not panel:FindFirstChild("Shadow") then
                local shadow = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                shadow.Name = "Shadow"
                shadow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 40, 1, 40)
                shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0, -20, 0, -20)
                shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                shadow.Image = "rbxassetid://5028857084"
                shadow.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                shadow.ImageTransparency = 0.5
                shadow.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
                shadow.SliceCenter = Rect.new(24, 24, 276, 276)
                shadow.ZIndex = math.max((panel.ZIndex or 1) - 1, 0)
                shadow.Parent = panel
            end
        end)

        if titleBar and titleBar.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = T.BgDeep
                titleBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
                titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
            end)
            pcall(function() trackBgFrame(titleBar, "BgDeep") end)
            pcall(function()
                local c = titleBar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
                if not c then
                    c = Instance.new("UICorner")
                    c.Parent = titleBar
                end
                c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local accent = titleBar:FindFirstChild("HubAccent")
                if not accent then
                    accent = Instance.new("Frame")
                    accent.Name = "HubAccent"
                    accent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2)
                    accent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -2)
                    accent.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    accent.ZIndex = (titleBar.ZIndex or 1) + 2
                    accent.Parent = titleBar
                end
                accent.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.c1
                trackSolid(accent, 1)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                for _, d in ipairs(titleBar:GetChildren()) do
                    if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        d.TextColor3 = T.Text
                        d.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            _NoxAttachSideImage(panel, titleBar)
        end)
    end
    _G._NoxStyleLikeHub = _NoxStyleLikeHub

    local GUI = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

    do

        local function tryParent(p)
            if parented or not p then return end
            local ok = pcall(function() GUI.Parent = p end)
            if ok and GUI.Parent == p then parented = true end
        end

        local _exec = ""

        local function paintBannerTheme()
            pcall(function()
                banner.BackgroundColor3 = T.Bg
                Title.TextColor3 = T.Text
                credit.TextColor3 = T.TextDim
                disc.TextColor3 = Theme.c1 or T.Primary
                if titleGrad then
                    titleGrad.Color = themeSeq()
                end
                -- border gradient + stroke follow accent
                if borderStroke and borderStroke.Parent then
                    local g = borderStroke:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
                    if g then
                        g.Color = themeSeq()
                    else
                        local ng = Instance.new("UIGradient")
                        ng.Color = themeSeq()
                        ng.Rotation = 90
                        ng.Parent = borderStroke
                        table.insert(ThemeGrads, {grad = ng, baseRot = 90, speed = 1})
                    end
                end
            end)
            -- force FPS/PING labels to recolor with new theme
            _lastBannerFps, _lastBannerPing = -1, -1
        end

        -- Entrée animée
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.12)
            TweenService:Create(banner, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 78)
            }):Play()
            task.wait(0.5)
            TweenService:Create(banner, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 82)
            }):Play()
        end)

        local _lastBannerFps, _lastBannerPing = -1, -1

        _bannerStatsRef = function(fps, ping)
            if not FpsLabel or not FpsLabel.Parent then return end
            fps = tonumber(fps) or 0
            ping = tonumber(ping) or 0
            if fps == _lastBannerFps and ping == _lastBannerPing then return end
            _lastBannerFps, _lastBannerPing = fps, ping

            local primary = Theme.c1 or T.Primary or Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147)
            local textCol = T.Text or Color3.fromRGB(245, 240, 255)
            local amber = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)
            local red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
            -- soft green tinted toward accent for ping OK
            local _h, _s, _v = Color3.toHSV(primary)
            local green = Color3.fromHSV(math.clamp(_h * 0.15 + 0.33, 0.28, 0.42), math.clamp(_s * 0.55, 0.35, 0.85), math.max(_v, 0.75))

            local fpsC = (fps >= 55 and primary) or (fps >= 30 and amber) or red
            local pingC = (ping <= 80 and green) or (ping <= 150 and amber) or red

            FpsLabel.Text = string.format(
                '<font color="rgb(%s)">FPS: </font><font color="rgb(%s)">%d</font><font color="rgb(%s)">  PING: </font><font color="rgb(%s)">%dms</font>',
                colToRgb(textCol), colToRgb(fpsC), fps, colToRgb(textCol), colToRgb(pingC), ping
            )
        end

        -- Repaint quand le thème change
        local _oldBroadcast = _G._NoxBroadcastTheme
        _G._NoxBroadcastTheme = function(...)
            if type(_oldBroadcast) == "function" then
                pcall(_oldBroadcast, ...)
            end
            paintBannerTheme()
            _lastBannerFps, _lastBannerPing = -1, -1
            if _sharedFps then
                local ping = 0
                pcall(function()
                    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
                    if lp then ping = math.floor((lp:GetNetworkPing() or 0) * 1000) end
                end)
                if _bannerStatsRef then _bannerStatsRef(_sharedFps, ping) end
            end
        end

        -- Fallback autonome
        task.spawn(function()
            local frameCount, lastTick, currentFps = 0, tick(), 60
            local conn
            conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not banner or not banner.Parent then
                    if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
                    return
                end
                frameCount = frameCount + 1
                local now = tick()
                if now - lastTick >= 0.5 then
                    currentFps = math.floor(frameCount / (now - lastTick) + 0.5)
                    frameCount = 0
                    lastTick = now
                end
            end)
            while banner and banner.Parent do
                if _isShuttingDown and _isShuttingDown() then break end
                local ping = 0
                pcall(function()
                    local item = StatsService.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]
                    if item then
                        ping = math.floor(item:GetValue() + 0.5)
                    end
                end)
                if ping == 0 then
                    pcall(function()
                        local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
                        if lp then
                            ping = math.floor((lp:GetNetworkPing() or 0) * 1000)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                local fps = (_sharedFps and _sharedFps > 0) and _sharedFps or currentFps
                if _bannerStatsRef then
                    _bannerStatsRef(fps, ping)
                end
                task.wait(0.4)
            end
            if conn then pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
        end)

        _G._NoxPaintBannerTheme = paintBannerTheme
        paintBannerTheme()
    end

    local WIN_W, WIN_H

        WIN_W, WIN_H = 380, 520
    else
        WIN_W, WIN_H = 420, 540

    local rootScale

    local function _applyUiScale()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then
            local _t = 0
            repeat task.wait(0.05); _t = _t + 0.05; cam = workspace.CurrentCamera until cam or _t > 3
        end
        local vp  = (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local gsz = GUI.AbsoluteSize
        if gsz and gsz.X > 1 and gsz.Y > 1 then vp = gsz end
        if vp.X < 1 or vp.Y < 1 then vp = Vector2.new(1280, 720) end
        local pct = (_UI.userPct or 100) / 100
        local scale
        if isMobile then
            local _short = math.min(vp.X, vp.Y)
            local _long  = math.max(vp.X, vp.Y)
            local _curPhone = _short < 600
            local base = math.clamp(math.min(_long / 1366, _short / 768), 0.50, 1.20)
            scale = base * (_curPhone and 0.78 or 0.95) * pct
        else
            local base = math.clamp(math.min(vp.X / 1920, vp.Y / 1080), 0.63, 1.62)
            scale = base * pct * 0.91
        end
        local fitW = (vp.X * 0.96) / WIN_W
        local fitH = (vp.Y * 0.94) / WIN_H
        local cap  = math.max(0.40, math.min(fitW, fitH))
        _UI.desiredScale = math.clamp(math.min(scale, cap), 0.40, 2.25)
        if rootScale then rootScale.Scale = _UI.desiredScale end
        for _, e in ipairs(_gScaleList) do
            e.sc.Scale = _UI.desiredScale * e.f
        end
    end

    local _uiScalePending = false
    local function _scheduleUiScale()
        if _uiScalePending then return end
        _uiScalePending = true
        task.delay(0.06, function()
            _uiScalePending = false
            _applyUiScale()
        end)
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        _applyUiScale()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then
            repeat task.wait(0.05); cam = workspace.CurrentCamera until cam
        end
        local function _connectCam(c)
            if c then pcall(function() c:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(_scheduleUiScale) end) end
        end
        _connectCam(cam)
        pcall(function()
            workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
                _connectCam(workspace.CurrentCamera)
                _scheduleUiScale()
            end)
        end)
        pcall(function() GUI:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(_scheduleUiScale) end)
        for _ = 1, 10 do task.wait(0.25); _scheduleUiScale() end
    end)

    local function makeColorDot(parent, xOffset, slot)
        local c = Instance.new("Frame")
        c.Name             = (slot == 1) and "ColorDotAccent" or "ColorDotBg"

        c.BorderSizePixel  = 0

        local _dc = Instance.new("UICorner")

        local ring = Instance.new("UIStroke")
