    -- Gummy Bypass: clear BlockTools/Web + delete GummyBear
    _G.GummyBypass = (function()
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local Player = Players.LocalPlayer

        local M = { enabled = false }
        local antiGummyRespawnGraceUntil = 0
        local childAddedConn = nil
        local charAddedConn = nil
        local loopRunning = false

        local function clearGummyToolBlockState(char)
            if not char then return end
            pcall(function()
                for _, inst in ipairs({ Player, char }) do
                    if inst then
                        if inst:GetAttribute("BlockTools") ~= nil then
                            inst:SetAttribute("BlockTools", false)
                        end
                        if inst:GetAttribute("Web") ~= nil then
                            inst:SetAttribute("Web", false)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if char:GetAttribute("BackpackReady") == false then
                    char:SetAttribute("BackpackReady", true)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function deleteGummyBears()
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if obj.Name == "GummyBear" then
                    pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end

        local function stopLoops()
            loopRunning = false
            if childAddedConn then
                pcall(function() childAddedConn:Disconnect() end)
                childAddedConn = nil
            end
            if charAddedConn then
                pcall(function() charAddedConn:Disconnect() end)
                charAddedConn = nil
            end
        end

        local function startLoops()
            stopLoops()
            loopRunning = true

            charAddedConn = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                task.wait(0.5)
                antiGummyRespawnGraceUntil = tick() + 1.5
            end)

            childAddedConn = Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if M.enabled and child.Name == "GummyBear" then
                    pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                end
            end)

            task.spawn(function()
                while loopRunning and M.enabled do
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    if not M.enabled then break end
                    local char = Player.Character
                    if char and tick() >= antiGummyRespawnGraceUntil then
                        clearGummyToolBlockState(char)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        function M.set(on)
            on = on and true or false
            M.enabled = on
            if on then
                deleteGummyBears()
                startLoops()
            else
                stopLoops()
            end
            -- Save is handled by Toggle() via setToggleSaved (same as Auto Steal)
        end

        function M.isEnabled()
            return M.enabled
        end

        table.insert(_G._FH_TEARDOWN, function()
            pcall(function()
                if M.set then M.set(false) end
            end)
        end)

        return M
    end)()

    -- PaintBall Bypass: block PaintballHitted UseItem OnClientEvent (Anti Paintball)
    _G.PaintBallBypass = (function()
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

        local M = {
            enabled = false,
            remote = nil,
            disabledConns = {},
        }

        local function resolveUseItemRemote()
            if M.remote and M.remote.Parent then
                return M.remote
            end
            M.remote = nil

            -- Prefer hub resolver if available
            if type(_G._FH_ResolveUseItemRemote) == "function" then
                local ok, r = pcall(_G._FH_ResolveUseItemRemote)
                if ok and typeof(r) == "Instance" and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    M.remote = r
                    return r
                end
            end

            -- Aimbot cache if present
            pcall(function()
                if Aimbot and type(Aimbot.findUseItemOnce) == "function" then
                    local r = Aimbot.findUseItemOnce()
                    if typeof(r) == "Instance" and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        M.remote = r
                    end
                end
            end)
            if M.remote then return M.remote end

            local ok, netFolder = pcall(function()
                return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Packages", 8):WaitForChild("Net", 8)
            end)
            if not ok or not netFolder then return nil end

            local getconns = (type(getconnections) == "function") and getconnections or nil
            local getconsts = (debug and type(debug.getconstants) == "function") and debug.getconstants
                or ((type(getconstants) == "function") and getconstants or nil)

            if getconns and getconsts then
                for _, r in ipairs(netFolder:GetChildren()) do
                    if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        local okC, conns = pcall(getconns, r.OnClientEvent)
                        if okC and type(conns) == "table" then
                            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
                                if type(c.Function) == "function" then
                                    local okK, consts = pcall(getconsts, c.Function)
                                    if okK and type(consts) == "table" then
                                        for _, k in ipairs(consts) do
                                            if k == "PaintballHitted" then
                                                M.remote = r
                                                return r
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            -- Fallback by name
            for _, r in ipairs(netFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") and tostring(r.Name):find("UseItem", 1, true) then
                    M.remote = r
                    return r
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function disableRemoteConns(remote)
            M.disabledConns = {}
            if not remote or type(getconnections) ~= "function" then return 0 end
            local n = 0
            local ok, conns = pcall(getconnections, remote.OnClientEvent)
            if ok and type(conns) == "table" then
                for _, conn in ipairs(conns) do
                    local disabled = false
                    pcall(function()
                        if conn.Function and conn.Disable then
                            conn:Disable()
                            disabled = true
                        end
                    end)
                    if not disabled then
                        pcall(function()
                            if conn.Disable then conn:Disable() disabled = true end
                        end)
                    end
                    if disabled then
                        table.insert(M.disabledConns, conn)
                        n = n + 1
                    end
                end
            end
            return n
        end

        local function enableRemoteConns()
            for _, conn in ipairs(M.disabledConns) do
                pcall(function()
                    if conn.Enable then conn:Enable() end
                end)
            end
            M.disabledConns = {}
        end

        local function enableAntiPaintball()
            task.spawn(function()
                local remote = resolveUseItemRemote()
                if remote then
                    local n = disableRemoteConns(remote)
                    pcall(function()
                        if showToast then
                            showToast("PaintBall Bypass ON (" .. tostring(n) .. ")", true)
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    pcall(function()
                        if showToast then
                            showToast("PaintBall remote not found", false)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function disableAntiPaintball()
            enableRemoteConns()
        end

        function M.set(on, skipSave)
            on = on and true or false
            if on == M.enabled then
                if on then enableAntiPaintball() end
                return
            end
            M.enabled = on
            if on then
                enableAntiPaintball()
            else
                disableAntiPaintball()
            end
            if not skipSave then
                pcall(function()
                    if setToggleSaved then
                        setToggleSaved("PaintBall Bypass", on)
                    elseif Config then
                        Config.set("toggle:PaintBall Bypass", on)
                        local t = Config.get("toggles", {})
                        if type(t) ~= "table" then t = {} end
                        t["PaintBall Bypass"] = on
                        Config.set("toggles", t)
                        if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                        if Config.save then Config.save() end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        function M.isEnabled()
            return M.enabled
        end

        table.insert(_G._FH_TEARDOWN, function()
            pcall(function()
                -- skipSave: do not overwrite saved toggle (same as Auto Steal)
                if M.set then M.set(false, true) end
            end)
        end)

        return M
    end)()

    -- Quick Grab: réduit HoldDuration des prompts sur TA base (0.1s)
    _G.QuickGrab = (function()
        local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
        local enabled = false
        local orig = {}
        local hooked = false

        local function isMyPlot(plot)
            if not plot or not plot:IsA("Model") then return false end
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            return sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase") and sign.YourBase.Enabled
        end

        local function inMyPlot(inst)
            if not inst or not inst.Parent then return false end
            local node = inst.Parent
            for _ = 1, 12 do
                if not node then return false end
                if node:IsA("Model") and node.Parent and node.Parent.Name == "Plots" then
                    return isMyPlot(node)
                end
                node = node.Parent
            end
            return false
        end

        local function installHook()
            if hooked then return end
            local ok, mt = pcall(getrawmetatable, game)
            if not ok or not mt then return end
            pcall(setreadonly, mt, false)
            local oldNewIndex = mt.__newindex
            local nc = newcclosure or function(f) return f end
            mt.__newindex = nc(function(self, key, value)
                if key == "HoldDuration"
                   and enabled
                   and typeof(self) == "Instance"
                   and self:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
                   and inMyPlot(self) then
                    value = 0.1
                end
                return oldNewIndex(self, key, value)
            end)
            pcall(setreadonly, mt, true)
            hooked = true
        end

        local function applyAll()
            local root = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots") or Workspace
            local stack = { root }
            local visited = 0
            while #stack > 0 do
                if not enabled then return end
                local cur = table.remove(stack)
                for _, d in ipairs(cur:GetChildren()) do
                    if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and inMyPlot(d) then
                        if orig[d] == nil then orig[d] = d.HoldDuration end
                        pcall(function() d.HoldDuration = 0.1 end)
                    end
                    table.insert(stack, d)
                end
                visited = visited + 1
                if visited % 50 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end

        local M = {}
        function M.set(v)
            enabled = v and true or false
            if enabled then
                installHook()
                task.spawn(applyAll)
            else
                for p, o in pairs(orig) do
                    if p and p.Parent then pcall(function() p.HoldDuration = o end) end
                end
                orig = {}
            end
        end
        function M.isEnabled()
            return enabled
        end
        return M
    end)()

    table.insert(_G._FH_TEARDOWN, function()
        pcall(function()
            if _G.QuickGrab and _G.QuickGrab.set then
                _G.QuickGrab.set(false)
            end
        end)
    end)

    _G.AllowFriends = (function()
        local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
        local M = {
            enabled = false,
            gui = nil,
            btn = nil,
            isDisallowed = false,
            cooldown = false,
        }

        local function colPrimary()
            if Theme and typeof(Theme.c1) == "Color3" then return Theme.c1 end
            return Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147)
        end
        local function colDeep()
            if T and typeof(T.BgDeep) == "Color3" then return T.BgDeep end
            return Color3.fromRGB(8, 6, 14)
        end
        local function colText()
            if T and typeof(T.Text) == "Color3" then return T.Text end
            return Color3.fromRGB(245, 240, 255)
        end

        local function fireAllFriendPanels()
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return 0 end
            local count = 0
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                local friendPanel = plot:FindFirstChild("FriendPanel", true)
                if friendPanel then
                    local main = friendPanel:FindFirstChild("Main")
                    local root = main or friendPanel
                    for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                        if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                            pcall(function()
                                if fireproximityprompt then
                                    fireproximityprompt(obj)
                                end
                            end)
                            count = count + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return count
        end

        local function paintBtn()
            if not M.btn then return end
            local primary = colPrimary()
            if M.isDisallowed then
                M.btn.Text = "Allow / Disallow"
                M.btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(31, 34, 40)
                pcall(function()
                    local s = M.btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if s then s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(104, 120, 255) end
                end)
            else
                M.btn.Text = "Allow / Disallow"
                M.btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(31, 34, 40)
                pcall(function()
                    local s = M.btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if s then s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(104, 120, 255) end
                end)
            end
            local lum = 0.299 * M.btn.BackgroundColor3.R + 0.587 * M.btn.BackgroundColor3.G + 0.114 * M.btn.BackgroundColor3.B
            M.btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 248)
        end

        local function build()
            if M.gui and M.gui.Parent then return end
            pcall(function()
                local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                local old = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("AllowFriendsGui")
                if old then old:Destroy() end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
                    local h = gethui()
                    local old = h and h:FindFirstChild("AllowFriendsGui")
                    if old then old:Destroy() end
                end
            end)

            local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            gui.Name = "AllowFriendsGui"
            gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            gui.DisplayOrder = 250
            gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            gui.Enabled = false
            M.gui = gui

            local parented = false
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
                    gui.Parent = gethui()
                    parented = gui.Parent ~= nil
                end
            end)
            if not parented then
                pcall(function()
                    gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
                    parented = gui.Parent ~= nil
                end)
            end
            if not parented then
                local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
                if pg then gui.Parent = pg end
            end

            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Name = "AllowFriendsBtn"
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 167, 0, 42)
            btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -180, 0, 12)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(31, 34, 40)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            btn.Text = "Allow / Disallow"
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            btn.TextSize = 14
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 248)
            btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            btn.Active = true
            btn.ZIndex = 10
            btn.Parent = gui
            M.btn = btn
            do
                local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
                c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
                c.Parent = btn
            end
            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(104, 120, 255)
            stroke.Thickness = 1.2
            stroke.Transparency = 0
            stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            stroke.Parent = btn

            local accent = Instance.new("Frame")
            accent.Name = "Accent"
            accent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 2)
            accent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, -6)
            accent.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            accent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            accent.BorderSizePixel = 0
            accent.ZIndex = 11
            accent.Parent = btn
            do
                local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
                c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                c.Parent = accent
            end

            paintBtn()

            pcall(function()
                if loadGuiPosition and loadGuiPosition("AllowFriendsGui", btn) then return end
                if Config then
                    local positions = Config.get("positions", {}) or {}
                    local p = positions["AllowFriendsGui"]
                    if type(p) == "table" and #p >= 4 then
                        btn.Position = UDim2.new(p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4])
                    end
                end
            end)

            local wasDragged = false
            local cooldown = false
            btn.Activated:Connect(function()
                if wasDragged then return end
                if cooldown then return end
                cooldown = true
                M.isDisallowed = not M.isDisallowed
                paintBtn()
                btn.TextTransparency = 0.45
                local n = fireAllFriendPanels()
                pcall(function()
                    if showToast then
                        showToast(M.isDisallowed and "Disallow Friends" or "Allow Friends", true)
                    end
                end)
                task.delay(1, function()
                    cooldown = false
                    if btn and btn.Parent then btn.TextTransparency = 0 end
                end)
            end)

            local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
            local function toV2(p)
                if p == nil then return Vector2.zero end
                if typeof(p) == "Vector2" then return p end
                if typeof(p) == "Vector3" then return Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) end
                return Vector2.new(tonumber(p.X) or 0, tonumber(p.Y) or 0)
            end
            local function savePos()
                pcall(function()
                    if saveGuiPosition then
                        saveGuiPosition("AllowFriendsGui", btn)
                    end
                    if Config then
                        local positions = Config.get("positions", {}) or {}
                        if type(positions) ~= "table" then positions = {} end
                        local pos = btn.Position
                        positions["AllowFriendsGui"] = {
                            pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset,
                        }
                        Config.set("positions", positions)
                        if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                    end
                end)
            end
            btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
                if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    wasDragged = false
                    dragging = true
                    dragStart = toV2(inp.Position)
                    startPos = btn.Position
                end
            end)
            UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
                if not dragging then return end
                if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                    and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                local d = toV2(inp.Position) - dragStart
                if d.Magnitude > 6 then wasDragged = true end
                btn.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
                )
            end)
            UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
                if not dragging then return end
                if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragging = false
                    if wasDragged then savePos() end
                    task.delay(0.05, function() wasDragged = false end)
                end
            end)
        end

        function M.set(on)
            on = on and true or false
            M.enabled = on
            if on then
                if not M.gui or not M.gui.Parent then build() end
                if M.gui then M.gui.Enabled = true end
                paintBtn()
            else
                if M.gui then M.gui.Enabled = false end
            end
            pcall(function()
                if Config then
                    Config.set("allow_friends_visible", on)
                    Config.set("toggle:Allow Friends", on)
                end
            end)
        end

        function M.isEnabled()
            return M.enabled
        end

        function M.repaint()
            paintBtn()
        end

        task.defer(function()
            pcall(build)
            if M.gui then M.gui.Enabled = false end
        end)

        return M
    end)()

                _G.AllowFriends.set(false)
            end
        end)
    end)

            pcall(function()
                local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
                local pg = lp and (lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui"))
                if pg then table.insert(parents, pg) end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if GUI then table.insert(parents, GUI) end
            end)
            for _, parent in ipairs(parents) do
                pcall(function()
                    local o = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if o then table.insert(found, o) end
                    for _, d in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d.Name == name then
                            table.insert(found, d)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            return found
        end

        local function centerScreenGui(sg)
            if not sg then return end
            pcall(function()
                local fr = sg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                if fr and fr:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    centerGui(fr)
                    return
                end
                for _, ch in ipairs(sg:GetChildren()) do
                    if ch:IsA("Frame") or ch:IsA("ImageLabel") or ch:IsA("TextButton") then
                        centerGui(ch)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            if Root then
                centerGui(Root)
            end
        end)

        -- Ne pas reset la position du bouton NOX (ReopenBtn) : on le laisse où il est

        local panelNames = {
            "PanelGui_Actions",
            "PanelGui_ActionsMobile",
            "PanelGui_NoxQuickPanel",
            "PanelGui_Nox Admin Spammer",
            "PanelGui_Command Cooldowns",
            "PanelGui_Booster",
            "PanelGui_Nox Defense",
            "PanelGui_Defense",
            "PanelGui_Nox Defense",
            "PanelGui_Instant Steal V2",
            "PanelGui_StealTarget",
            "PanelGui_Admin Panel",
        }
        for _, name in ipairs(panelNames) do
            for _, obj in ipairs(findNamed(name)) do
                if obj:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                    centerScreenGui(obj)
                elseif obj:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    centerGui(obj)
                end
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            if Config then
                -- Préserve la position du bouton NOX si elle existe dans positions
                local positions = Config.get("positions", {}) or {}
                local reopenPos = nil
                if type(positions) == "table" then
                    reopenPos = positions["KscHubReopen"] or positions["NoxReopenBtn"] or positions["reopen"]
                end
                local savedReopen = Config.get("reopen_pos", nil)

                Config.set("positions", {})
                if reopenPos then
                    local newPos = {}
                    newPos["KscHubReopen"] = reopenPos
                    if positions["NoxReopenBtn"] then newPos["NoxReopenBtn"] = positions["NoxReopenBtn"] end
                    Config.set("positions", newPos)
                end
                -- Ne pas effacer reopen_pos
                if savedReopen ~= nil then
                    Config.set("reopen_pos", savedReopen)
                end
                Config.set("root_pos", nil)
                Config.set("actions_panel_pos", nil)
                Config.set("isv2_panel_pos", nil)
                if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            if showToast then showToast("GUI reset (center)", true) end
        end)
    end)

    Button(ConfigTab.scroll, "Reload Config", "Re-read config from disk", function()
        pcall(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            local FILE = "NoxHub/config.json"
            local FILE_BAK = "NoxHub/config.bak.json"
            local function tryDecode(path)
                if isfile and readfile and isfile(path) then
                    local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(path)) end)
                    if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then return decoded end
                end
            end
            local d = tryDecode(FILE) or tryDecode(FILE_BAK)
            if d and Config then
                Config.data = d
                if _G._NoxReapplyToggles then
                    task.defer(function() pcall(_G._NoxReapplyToggles) end)
                end
                if showToast then showToast("Config reloaded", true) end
            else
                if showToast then showToast("No config file", false) end
            end
        end)
    end)

    Section(ConfigTab.scroll, "Export / Import")
    Button(ConfigTab.scroll, "Export Config", "Download config as .txt + clipboard", function()
        pcall(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            if not Config or type(Config.data) ~= "table" then
                if showToast then showToast("No config data", false) end
                return
            end
            if Config.flush then pcall(function() Config.flush() end) end
            local ok, encoded = pcall(function()
                return HttpService:JSONEncode(Config.data)
            end)
            if not ok or type(encoded) ~= "string" or #encoded < 2 then
                if showToast then showToast("Encode failed", false) end
                return
            end
            local EXPORT_TXT = "NoxHub/config_export.txt"
            local EXPORT_JSON = "NoxHub/config_export.json" -- keep legacy for import compat
            pcall(function()
                if makefolder then
                    if not (isfolder and isfolder("NoxHub")) then makefolder("NoxHub") end
                end
            end)
            local wrote = false
            pcall(function()
                if writefile then
                    writefile(EXPORT_TXT, encoded)
                    wrote = true
                    pcall(function() writefile(EXPORT_JSON, encoded) end)
                end
            end)
            local clipped = false
            pcall(function()
                if setclipboard then
                    setclipboard(encoded)
                    clipped = true
                elseif toclipboard then
                    toclipboard(encoded)
                    clipped = true
                end
            end)
            local msg = "Exported"
            if wrote then msg = msg .. " → " .. EXPORT_TXT end
            if clipped then msg = msg .. " (+ clipboard)" end
            if showToast then showToast(msg, true) end
        end)
    end)
    Button(ConfigTab.scroll, "Import Config", "From NoxHub/config_export.txt", function()
        pcall(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            if not Config then
                if showToast then showToast("Config unavailable", false) end
                return
            end
            local candidates = {
                "NoxHub/config_export.txt",
                "NoxHub/config_export.json",
                "NoxHub/import.json",
                "NoxHub/import.txt",
                "NoxHub/config.json",
            }
            local decoded = nil
            local used = nil
            for _, path in ipairs(candidates) do
                local okRead, body = pcall(function()
                    if isfile and isfile(path) and readfile then
                        return readfile(path)
                    end
                end)
                if okRead and type(body) == "string" and #body > 2 then
                    local okJ, data = pcall(function()
                        return HttpService:JSONDecode(body)
                    end)
                    if okJ and type(data) == "table" then
                        decoded = data
                        used = path
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not decoded then
                if showToast then showToast("No import file found", false) end
                return
            end
            if type(Config.data) ~= "table" then Config.data = {} end
            for k, v in pairs(decoded) do
                Config.data[k] = v
            end
            Config._dirty = true
            pcall(function()
                if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                if Config.save then Config.save() end
            end)
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G._NoxReapplyToggles then _G._NoxReapplyToggles() end
                end)
            end)
            if showToast then showToast("Imported: " .. tostring(used), true) end
        end)
    end)
    Button(ConfigTab.scroll, "Import Clipboard", "Paste JSON from clipboard", function()
        pcall(function()
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            if not Config then return end
            local body = nil
            pcall(function()
                if getclipboard then body = getclipboard() end
            end)
            if type(body) ~= "string" or #body < 2 then
                if showToast then showToast("Clipboard empty", false) end
                return
            end
            body = body:gsub("^```json%s*", ""):gsub("^```%s*", ""):gsub("%s*```$", "")
            local okJ, data = pcall(function()
                return HttpService:JSONDecode(body)
            end)
            if not okJ or type(data) ~= "table" then
                if showToast then showToast("Invalid JSON clipboard", false) end
                return
            end
            if type(Config.data) ~= "table" then Config.data = {} end
            for k, v in pairs(data) do
                Config.data[k] = v
            end
            Config._dirty = true
            pcall(function()
                if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                if Config.save then Config.save() end
            end)
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G._NoxReapplyToggles then _G._NoxReapplyToggles() end
                end)
            end)
            if showToast then showToast("Imported from clipboard", true) end
        end)
    end)

        local function importFromText(raw)
            local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
            if not Config then
                if showToast then showToast("Config unavailable", false) end
                return false
            end
            if type(raw) ~= "string" then
                if showToast then showToast("Empty text", false) end
                return false
            end
            raw = raw:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if #raw < 2 then
                if showToast then showToast("Empty text", false) end
                return false
            end
            raw = raw:gsub("^```json%s*", ""):gsub("^```%s*", ""):gsub("%s*```$", "")
            local okJ, data = pcall(function()
                return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
            end)
            if not okJ or type(data) ~= "table" then
                if showToast then showToast("JSON invalide", false) end
                return false
            end
            if type(Config.data) ~= "table" then Config.data = {} end
            for k, v in pairs(data) do
                Config.data[k] = v
            end
            Config._dirty = true
            pcall(function()
                if Config.flush then Config.flush() end
                if Config.save then Config.save() end
            end)
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G._NoxReapplyToggles then _G._NoxReapplyToggles() end
                end)
            end)
            if showToast then showToast("Config importée", true) end
            return true
        end

        Button(ConfigTab.scroll, "Import Pasted Config", "Import JSON from the box above", function()
            local box = _G._NoxConfigPasteBox
            local text = box and box.Text or ""
            importFromText(text)
        end)
    end

        HueCursor.Position               = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
        HueCursor.BackgroundColor3       = T.White
        HueCursor.BorderSizePixel        = 0
        HueCursor.ZIndex                 = 102
        HueCursor.Parent                 = HueBar
        Corner(HueCursor, 12)
        Stroke(HueCursor, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), 1, 0.3)

        local ApplyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        ApplyBtn.Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 182, 0, 44)
        ApplyBtn.Position               = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 162)
        ApplyBtn.BackgroundColor3       = Theme.c1
        ApplyBtn.BorderSizePixel        = 0
        ApplyBtn.Text                   = ""
        ApplyBtn.AutoButtonColor        = false
        ApplyBtn.ZIndex                 = 101
        ApplyBtn.Parent                 = Picker
        Corner(ApplyBtn, 12)
        local applyStroke = Stroke(ApplyBtn, T.White, 1.4, 0.3)
        ApplyBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(applyStroke, F, {Transparency = 0}) end)
        ApplyBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(applyStroke, F, {Transparency = 0.3}) end)

        local pickerState = {slot = 1, h = 0.75, s = 1, v = 0.97, pending = Theme.c1}

        local function updatePickerVisuals()
            local col = Color3.fromHSV(pickerState.h, pickerState.s, pickerState.v)
            pickerState.pending       = col
            SV.BackgroundColor3       = Color3.fromHSV(pickerState.h, 1, 1)
            SVCursor.Position         = UDim2.new(pickerState.s, 0, 1 - pickerState.v, 0)
            HueCursor.Position        = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, pickerState.h, 0)
            ApplyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = col
        end

        local function rgbToHsv(c)
            local r, g, b = c.R, c.G, c.B
            local mx = math.max(r, g, b)
            local mn = math.min(r, g, b)
            local d  = mx - mn
            local h  = 0
            if d > 0 then
                if mx == r then     h = ((g - b)/d) % 6
                elseif mx == g then h = ((b - r)/d) + 2
                else                h = ((r - g)/d) + 4 end
                h = h / 6
                if h < 0 then h = h + 1 end
            end
            local s = (mx > 0) and (d / mx) or 0
            return h, s, mx
        end

        local function openPicker(slot)
            pickerState.slot = slot
            local current = (slot == 1) and Theme.c1 or T.Bg
            pickerState.h, pickerState.s, pickerState.v = rgbToHsv(current)
            updatePickerVisuals()
            local guiSz = GUI.AbsoluteSize
            if isMobile then
                local px = math.max(4, math.floor((guiSz.X - 208) / 2))
                local py = math.max(4, math.floor((guiSz.Y - 214) / 2))
                Picker.Position = UDim2.new(0, px, 0, py)
            else
                local dot = (slot == 1) and Dot1 or Dot2
                local pos = dot.AbsolutePosition
                local px = math.max(8, math.min(pos.X - 100, guiSz.X - 216))
                local py = pos.Y + 24
                Picker.Position = UDim2.new(0, px, 0, py)
            end
            Picker.Visible = true
        end

        local function persistTheme()
            Config.set("theme_c1", { math.floor(Theme.c1.R*255+0.5), math.floor(Theme.c1.G*255+0.5), math.floor(Theme.c1.B*255+0.5) })
            Config.set("theme_c2", { math.floor(Theme.c2.R*255+0.5), math.floor(Theme.c2.G*255+0.5), math.floor(Theme.c2.B*255+0.5) })
            Config.set("theme_bg",  { math.floor(T.Bg.R*255+0.5),    math.floor(T.Bg.G*255+0.5),    math.floor(T.Bg.B*255+0.5)    })
        end

        local function applyLive()
            local col = pickerState.pending
            if pickerState.slot == 1 then
                -- Gamma-style accent apply
                Theme.c1 = col
                T.Primary = col
                T.Green = col
                if Dot1 then Dot1.BackgroundColor3 = col end
                if type(SetAccentColor) == "function" then
                    pcall(SetAccentColor, col)
                elseif type(Repaint) == "function" then
                    pcall(Repaint)
                end
            else
                -- Gamma-style background apply
                SetGuiColor(col)
                if Dot2 then Dot2.BackgroundColor3 = T.Bg end
            end
            persistTheme()
            pcall(function()
                if type(_G._NoxBroadcastTheme) == "function" then
                    _G._NoxBroadcastTheme()
                end
            end)
        end

        local function applyPicked()
            applyLive()
            persistTheme()
        end

        local function wireDot(btn, slot)
            if not btn then return end
            local function fire()
                pcall(openPicker, slot)
            end
            btn.Activated:Connect(fire)
            pcall(function()
                btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fire)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
                    if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                        or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        fire()
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
        wireDot(Dot1Btn, 1)
        wireDot(Dot2Btn, 2)
        -- Also allow clicking the frame itself
        pcall(function()
            if Dot1 then
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Name = "Dot1FrameHit"
                b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                b.Text = ""
                b.ZIndex = 62
                b.Parent = Dot1
                wireDot(b, 1)
            end
            if Dot2 then
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
                b.Name = "Dot2FrameHit"
                b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                b.Text = ""
                b.ZIndex = 62
                b.Parent = Dot2
                wireDot(b, 2)
            end
        end)
        CloseBtn.Activated:Connect(function() Picker.Visible = false end)
        ApplyBtn.Activated:Connect(applyPicked)

        local svDragging, hueDragging = false, false
        SV.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                svDragging = true
                local pos  = SV.AbsolutePosition
                local size = SV.AbsoluteSize
                pickerState.s = math.clamp((inp.Position.X - pos.X) / size.X, 0, 1)
                pickerState.v = 1 - math.clamp((inp.Position.Y - pos.Y) / size.Y, 0, 1)
                updatePickerVisuals(); applyLive()
            end
        end)
        SV.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then svDragging = false end
        end)
        HueBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                hueDragging = true
                local pos  = HueBar.AbsolutePosition
                local size = HueBar.AbsoluteSize
                pickerState.h = math.clamp((inp.Position.Y - pos.Y) / size.Y, 0, 1)
                updatePickerVisuals(); applyLive()
            end
        end)
        HueBar.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then hueDragging = false end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            if svDragging then
                local pos  = SV.AbsolutePosition
                local size = SV.AbsoluteSize
                pickerState.s = math.clamp((inp.Position.X - pos.X) / size.X, 0, 1)
                pickerState.v = 1 - math.clamp((inp.Position.Y - pos.Y) / size.Y, 0, 1)
                updatePickerVisuals()
                applyLive()
            elseif hueDragging then
                local pos  = HueBar.AbsolutePosition
                local size = HueBar.AbsoluteSize
                pickerState.h = math.clamp((inp.Position.Y - pos.Y) / size.Y, 0, 1)
                updatePickerVisuals()
                applyLive()
            end
        end)
    end)()

    task.defer(function()
        pcall(function()
            local saved = Config and Config.get and Config.get("auto_giant_potion", false)
            if saved and _G.AutoBigPotion and _G.AutoBigPotion.set then
                _G.AutoBigPotion.set(true)

    local function _NoxBroadcastTheme()
        local primary = (Theme and Theme.c1) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147)
        local bg = (T and T.Bg) or Color3.fromRGB(18, 16, 14)
        local deep = (T and T.BgDeep) or Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 9)
        local card = (T and T.Card) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 24, 20)
        local soft = (T and T.Soft) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 28, 22)
        local text = (T and T.Text) or Color3.fromRGB(250, 245, 235)

        _G.coreTheme = _G.coreTheme or {}
        _G.coreTheme.primary = primary
        _G.coreTheme.secondary = text
        _G.coreTheme.bg = bg
        _G.coreTheme.card = card

        local modules = {
            _G.QuickAdminPanel, _G.AdminSpammer, _G.CommandCooldowns, _G.BoosterGUI,
            _G.TPBrainrot, _G.DropBrainrot,
            _G.ActionsPanel, _G.ActionsPanelMobile, _G.DefensePanel, _G.InstantStealV2, _G.StealTarget,
            _G.PlayerESP, _G.CloneESP, _G.TimerESP, _G.MineESP, _G.APESP, _G.BrainrotESP,
            _G.AllowDisallowESP, _G.AllowFriends, _G._FH_CD_Panel, _G.FPSBooster, _G.GameStretcher,
            _G.DiscordLabel,
        }
        for _, mod in ipairs(modules) do
            if type(mod) == "table" then
                if type(mod.repaint) == "function" then
                    pcall(mod.repaint)
                elseif type(mod.applyTheme) == "function" then
                    pcall(mod.applyTheme, primary, text)
                end
            end
        end

        -- Repaint all hub toggles to match current accent / bg theme
        pcall(function()
            local reg = _G._NoxToggleReg
            if type(reg) == "table" then
                for _, ctrl in pairs(reg) do
                    if type(ctrl) == "table" and type(ctrl.refreshTheme) == "function" then
                        pcall(ctrl.refreshTheme)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(_G._NoxPaintBannerTheme) == "function" then
                _G._NoxPaintBannerTheme()
            end
        end)

        local names = {
            "PanelGui_Actions", "PanelGui_ActionsMobile", "PanelGui_NoxQuickPanel", "PanelGui_Nox Admin Spammer",
            "PanelGui_Command Cooldowns", "PanelGui_Booster", "PanelGui_Nox Defense",
            "PanelGui_Defense", "PanelGui_Nox Defense", "PanelGui_Instant Steal V2",
            "PanelGui_StealTarget", "NoxHubBanner", "KscHubReopen",
        }
        local parents = {}
        pcall(function()
            if type(gethui) == "function" then
                local h = gethui()
                if h then table.insert(parents, h) end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function() table.insert(parents, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
        pcall(function()
            local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
            local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if pg then table.insert(parents, pg) end
        end)
        pcall(function() if GUI then table.insert(parents, GUI) end end)

        local function recolorTree(root)
            if not root then return end
            pcall(function()
                for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "Frame" or d.Name == "Main") then
                        if d.BackgroundTransparency < 0.95 then
                            d.BackgroundColor3 = bg
                        end
                    end
                    if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "TitleBar" or d.Name == "Header" or d.Name == "CDHdr") then
                        d.BackgroundColor3 = deep
                    end
                    if d:IsA("UIGradient") then
                        pcall(function()
                            d.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, primary),
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
                            })
                        end)
                    end
                    if d:IsA("UIStroke") and not d:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") then
                        if d.Thickness and d.Thickness <= 2.5 then
                            pcall(function() d.Color = primary end)
                        end
                    end
                    if d:IsA("Frame") and (d.Name == "Badge" or d.Name == "Accent" or d.Name == "LogoBadge" or d.Name == "LogoBox") then
                        d.BackgroundColor3 = primary
                    end
                    if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Name ~= "StatusLabel" then
                        if d.Parent and (d.Parent.Name == "TitleBar" or d.Parent.Name == "Header") then
                            d.TextColor3 = text
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        for _, parent in ipairs(parents) do
            for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                pcall(function()
                    local o = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if o then
                        recolorTree(o)
                        if type(_G._NoxStyleLikeHub) == "function" then
                            local frame = o:IsA("ScreenGui") and (o:FindFirstChild("Frame") or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Frame")) or o
                            if frame and frame:IsA("GuiObject") then
                                local tb = frame:FindFirstChild("TitleBar") or frame:FindFirstChild("Header") or frame:FindFirstChild("CDHdr")
                                _G._NoxStyleLikeHub(frame, tb)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            local rb = _G._FH_ReopenBtn
            if rb then
                rb.BackgroundColor3 = primary
                local lum = 0.299 * primary.R + 0.587 * primary.G + 0.114 * primary.B
                rb.TextColor3 = (lum > 0.55) and Color3.fromRGB(12, 6, 22) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                for _, d in ipairs(rb:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("UIStroke") then d.Color = primary end
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if PageTitle then PageTitle.TextColor3 = primary end
            if typeof(LogoBadge) == "Instance" then LogoBadge.BackgroundColor3 = primary end
            if Dot1 then Dot1.BackgroundColor3 = primary end
            if Dot2 then Dot2.BackgroundColor3 = bg end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            if GUI then
                local ban = GUI:FindFirstChild("NoxHubBanner")
                if ban then recolorTree(ban) end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(_G._NoxPaintBannerTheme) == "function" then
                _G._NoxPaintBannerTheme()
            end
        end)
    end
    _G._NoxBroadcastTheme = _NoxBroadcastTheme

            local wantDrop = false

                _G.DropBrainrot.set(true)
            end

        end

    rootScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    rootScale.Scale  = _UI.desiredScale
    rootScale.Parent = Root
    if Vis then Vis.rootScale = rootScale end
    pcall(function()
        if _G.__NoxBridge then _G.__NoxBridge.rootScale = rootScale end
    end)

    local POP_IN  = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local POP_OUT = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

    visible = Config.get("hub_open", true)
    if not visible then
        Root.Visible    = false
        rootScale.Scale = 0
    end

    local curVisTween = nil
    setVisible = function(show)
        show = show and true or false
        if show == visible then
            if show and Root and not Root.Visible then
                Root.Visible = true
                if rootScale then rootScale.Scale = _UI.desiredScale or 1 end
            end
            return
        end
        visible = show
        if Vis then Vis.open = show end
        Config.set("hub_open", show)
        if curVisTween then pcall(function() curVisTween:Cancel() end) end
        if show then
            Root.Visible = true
            if rootScale then
                if rootScale.Scale < 0.01 then rootScale.Scale = (_UI.desiredScale or 1) * 0.85 end
                curVisTween = TweenService:Create(rootScale, POP_IN, {Scale = _UI.desiredScale or 1})
                curVisTween:Play()
            end
        else
            if Picker then Picker.Visible = false end
            if rootScale then
                curVisTween = TweenService:Create(rootScale, POP_OUT, {Scale = 0})
                local t = curVisTween
                t.Completed:Connect(function(state)
                    if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and not visible then
                        Root.Visible = false
                    end
                end)
                t:Play()
            else
                Root.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
    if Vis then
        Vis.set = setVisible
        Vis.open = visible
        Vis.rootScale = rootScale
    end
    _G._FH_SetVisible = setVisible
    _G._FH_Vis = Vis
    if _G.__NoxBridge then
        _G.__NoxBridge.setVisible = setVisible
        _G.__NoxBridge.visible = visible
        _G.__NoxBridge.rootScale = rootScale
        _G.__NoxBridge.Vis = Vis
    end

        end)
    end)



-- (old GUI resize system removed)



    end)

end)



-- KSC: resize arrows (keep) — drag corner to resize panels freely
do
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local handles = {}

    local function getConfig()
        return _G.KscHubConfig or _G.NoxHubConfig
    end
    -- helpers live in another scope: reach them through _G._NoxSave
    local loadGuiSize     = _G._NoxSave and _G._NoxSave.loadSize
    local saveGuiSize     = _G._NoxSave and _G._NoxSave.saveSize
    local loadGuiPosition = _G._NoxSave and _G._NoxSave.loadPos
    local saveGuiPosition = _G._NoxSave and _G._NoxSave.savePos

    local function attachResizeTriangle(frame, opts)
        if not frame or not frame:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
        if handles[frame] and handles[frame].Parent then return end
        opts = opts or {}
        local minW = opts.minW or 40
        local minH = opts.minH or 30
        local maxW = opts.maxW or 1200
        local maxH = opts.maxH or 1200
        local saveKey = opts.saveKey

        for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "_NoxResizeHandle" or child.Name == "_NoxResizeTriangle"
                or child.Name == "ResizeHandle" or child.Name == "_ResizeHandle" then
                pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
            end
        end

        local handle = Instance.new("TextButton")
        handle.Name = "_NoxResizeHandle"
        handle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
        handle.Position = UDim2.new(1, -1, 1, -1)
        handle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
        handle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 40)
        handle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
        handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
        handle.Text = "↘"
        handle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        handle.TextSize = 14
        handle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        handle.AutoButtonColor = false
        handle.Active = true
        handle.ZIndex = 1000
        handle.Parent = frame
        local hc = Instance.new("UICorner")
        hc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        hc.Parent = handle

        -- restore saved size if any
        pcall(function()
            local cfg = getConfig()
            if not saveKey then return end
            local function applySaved()
                local sizes = (cfg and cfg.get and cfg.get("panelSizes", {})) or {}
                if type(sizes) ~= "table" then sizes = {} end
                local s = sizes[saveKey]
                local collapsedNow = _G.KscCollapse and _G.KscCollapse.get(saveKey)
                if collapsedNow then
                    -- keep the panel collapsed (title bar only), just restore its width
                    if type(s) == "table" and tonumber(s[1]) then
                        frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.clamp(tonumber(s[1]), minW, maxW), 0, frame.Size.Y.Offset)
                    end
                elseif type(s) == "table" and tonumber(s[1]) and tonumber(s[2]) then
                    local w = math.clamp(tonumber(s[1]), minW, maxW)
                    local h = math.clamp(tonumber(s[2]), minH, maxH)
                    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
                elseif type(loadGuiSize) == "function" then
                    loadGuiSize(saveKey, frame, minW, minH)
                end
                local positions = (cfg and cfg.get and cfg.get("panelPositions", {})) or {}
                if type(positions) ~= "table" then positions = {} end
                local p = positions[saveKey]
                if type(p) == "table" and #p >= 4 then
                    frame.Position = UDim2.new(tonumber(p[1]) or 0, tonumber(p[2]) or 0, tonumber(p[3]) or 0, tonumber(p[4]) or 0)
                elseif type(loadGuiPosition) == "function" then
                    loadGuiPosition(saveKey, frame)
                end
            end
            applySaved()
            -- re-apply shortly after (wins against restyle/fitHeight)
            task.delay(0.4, function() if frame and frame.Parent then applySaved() end end)
            task.delay(1.2, function() if frame and frame.Parent then applySaved() end end)
        end)

        local dragging = false
        local startPos, startSize

        local function getScale()
            local sc = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
            local s = sc and tonumber(sc.Scale) or 1
            if not s or s < 0.05 then s = 1 end
            return s
        end

        local function beginResize(pos)
            if _G._FH_GuiLocked then return end
            if dragging then return end -- already started by InputBegan: don't overwrite startPos
            dragging = true
            startPos = pos
            -- use layout size (Offset), not AbsoluteSize (avoids UIScale shrink jump)
            local w = frame.Size.X.Offset
            local h = frame.Size.Y.Offset
            if w < 20 or h < 20 then
                local s = getScale()
                w = frame.AbsoluteSize.X / s
                h = frame.AbsoluteSize.Y / s
            end
            startSize = Vector2.new(w, h)
        end

        handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            beginResize(inp.Position)
        end)
        handle.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            if dragging then return end
            local pos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
            local inset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            pcall(function() inset = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset() end)
            beginResize(Vector3.new(pos.X - inset.X, pos.Y - inset.Y, 0))
        end)

        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
            if not dragging then return end
            if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            if not frame or not frame.Parent then return end
            if _G._FH_GuiLocked then dragging = false return end
            local s = getScale()
            local dx = (inp.Position.X - startPos.X) / s
            local dy = (inp.Position.Y - startPos.Y) / s
            local newW = math.clamp(startSize.X + dx, minW, maxW)
            local newH = math.clamp(startSize.Y + dy, minH, maxH)
            frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(newW + 0.5), math.floor(newH + 0.5))
        end)

        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
            if inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                and inp.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            if not dragging then return end
            dragging = false
            pcall(function()
                local cfg = getConfig()
                if not cfg or not frame then return end
                local key = saveKey
                if not key then
                    local sg = frame
                    while sg and not sg:IsA("ScreenGui") do sg = sg.Parent end
                    key = sg and sg.Name
                end
                if not key then return end
                local sizes = cfg.get and cfg.get("panelSizes", {}) or {}
                if type(sizes) ~= "table" then sizes = {} end
                if not (_G.KscCollapse and _G.KscCollapse.get(key)) then
                    sizes[key] = { frame.Size.X.Offset, frame.Size.Y.Offset }
                end
                cfg.set("panelSizes", sizes)
                local positions = cfg.get and cfg.get("panelPositions", {}) or {}
                if type(positions) ~= "table" then positions = {} end
                local pos = frame.Position
                positions[key] = { pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset }
                cfg.set("panelPositions", positions)
                if cfg.flush then pcall(function() cfg.flush() end) end
                if cfg.save then pcall(function() cfg.save() end) end
                if type(saveGuiSize) == "function" then pcall(saveGuiSize, key, frame) end
                if type(saveGuiPosition) == "function" then pcall(saveGuiPosition, key, frame) end
            end)
        end)

        handles[frame] = handle
        frame.Destroying:Connect(function() handles[frame] = nil end)
    end

    local function getMainFrame(gui)
        if not gui then return nil end
        local f = gui:FindFirstChild("Frame") or gui:FindFirstChild("Root")
        if f and f:IsA("GuiObject") and (f.AbsoluteSize.X >= 50 or f.Size.X.Offset >= 50) then return f end
        local best, bestA = nil, 0
        for _, ch in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("GuiObject") and not ch:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                local a = math.max(ch.AbsoluteSize.X * ch.AbsoluteSize.Y, ch.Size.X.Offset * ch.Size.Y.Offset)
                if a > bestA and (ch.AbsoluteSize.X >= 50 or ch.Size.X.Offset >= 50) then
                    bestA, best = a, ch
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local PANEL_NAMES = {
        ["PanelGui_StealTarget"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_Command Cooldowns"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_Booster"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_Actions"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_ActionsMobile"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_Instant Steal"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_Instant Steal V2"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_Admin Panel"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_Nox Defense"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_Defense"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_Nox Admin Spammer"] = true,
        ["PanelGui_NoxQuickPanel"] = true,
        ["StealProgressScreenGui"] = true,
    }

    local function scanAndAttach()
        local parents = {}
        pcall(function()
            local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            if pg then table.insert(parents, pg) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(gethui) == "function" then
                local h = gethui()
                if h then table.insert(parents, h) end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function() table.insert(parents, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)

        for _, parent in ipairs(parents) do
            for _, gui in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                    local name = gui.Name
                    if name == "KscHub" or name == "NoxHub" or name == "FluxHub" then
                        local root = gui:FindFirstChild("Root")
                        if root and root:IsA("GuiObject") then
                            attachResizeTriangle(root, {
                                minW = 180, minH = 160, maxW = 900, maxH = 900,
                                saveKey = "KscHub_Root",
                            })
                        end
                    elseif PANEL_NAMES[name] or name:find("PanelGui_") == 1 then
                        local frame = getMainFrame(gui)
                        if frame then
                            local mins = { minW = 40, minH = 30 }
                            if name:find("StealTarget") or name:find("Actions") then
                                mins = { minW = 35, minH = 28 }
                            end
                            if name:find("Booster") then
                                mins = { minW = 160, minH = 100 } -- keep Enabled + More Settings visible
                            end
                            attachResizeTriangle(frame, {
                                minW = mins.minW, minH = mins.minH,
                                maxW = 1200, maxH = 1200,
                                saveKey = name,
                            })
                            -- phone: light scale only, do not force Size (avoids join/leave resize bug)
                            pcall(function()
                                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                                local short = cam and math.min(cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y) or 800
                                if short < 600 then
                                    local sc = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
                                    if not sc then
                                        sc = Instance.new("UIScale")
                                        sc.Parent = frame
                                    end
                                    if sc.Scale > 0.85 or sc.Scale == 1 then
                                        sc.Scale = 0.78
                                    end
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    _G._NoxAttachResize = attachResizeTriangle
    _G._KscAttachResize = attachResizeTriangle

    task.spawn(function()
        for _ = 1, 40 do
            task.wait(0.3)
            pcall(scanAndAttach)
        end
        while true do
            task.wait(2)
            pcall(scanAndAttach)
        end
    end)

    local function watch(parent)
        if not parent then return end
        pcall(function()
            parent.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                task.wait(0.2)
                if child:IsA("ScreenGui") then pcall(scanAndAttach) end
            end)
        end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        watch(LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 8))
    end)
    pcall(function() if gethui then watch(gethui()) end end)
    pcall(function() watch(game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
end


-- KSC: restyle floating panels to match main hub theme
task.spawn(function()
    local function col()
        return {
            bg = (T and T.Bg) or Color3.fromRGB(18, 19, 25),
            deep = (T and T.BgDeep) or Color3.fromRGB(13, 14, 19),
            card = (T and T.Card) or Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 38),
            line = (T and T.Primary) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147),
            text = (T and T.Text) or Color3.fromRGB(242, 243, 247),
            dim = (T and T.TextDim) or Color3.fromRGB(165, 168, 180),
        }
    end
    local function stylePanel(gui)
        if not gui or not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then return end
        local name = gui.Name or ""
        if not (name:find("PanelGui_") == 1 or name == "StealProgressScreenGui") then return end
        local C = col()
        for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Frame") or d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                -- skip tiny toggle/switch frames (keep ON accent color)
                local abs = d.AbsoluteSize
                if abs.X > 0 and abs.X < 80 and abs.Y > 0 and abs.Y < 40 then
                    -- skip
                elseif d.Name == "_NoxResizeHandle" then
                    -- skip
                else
                    local bg = d.BackgroundColor3
                    local _h, _sat, _val = Color3.toHSV(bg)
                    local isAccent = (_sat > 0.3 and _val > 0.35)
                    if isAccent then
                        -- blue/active element: leave it alone
                    elseif d.BackgroundTransparency < 0.95 and abs.X >= 80 then
                        pcall(function() d.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg end)
                    end
                    if (not isAccent) and bg.R < 0.08 and bg.G < 0.08 and bg.B < 0.08 and abs.X >= 80 then
                        pcall(function() d.BackgroundColor3 = C.deep end)
                    end
                end
            elseif d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
                pcall(function()
                    if d.TextColor3.R > 0.5 then
                        d.TextColor3 = C.text
                    end
                end)
            elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then
                pcall(function()
                    d.Color = C.line
                    d.Transparency = math.max(d.Transparency, 0.35)
                    d.Thickness = math.min(d.Thickness, 1.2)
                end)
            end
        end
        local main = gui:FindFirstChild("Frame") or gui:FindFirstChild("Root")
        if main and main:IsA("GuiObject") then
            pcall(function() main.BackgroundColor3 = C.bg end)
        end
    end
    local function scan()
        local parents = {}
        pcall(function()
            if gethui then table.insert(parents, gethui()) end
        end)
        pcall(function() table.insert(parents, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
        pcall(function()
            local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            if lp then table.insert(parents, lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")) end
        end)
        for _, p in ipairs(parents) do
            if p then
                for _, ch in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
                    pcall(stylePanel, ch)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _ = 1, 6 do
        task.wait(0.35)
        pcall(scan)
    end
    -- stop restyle loop early so saved sizes/colors stay
    pcall(function()
        local h = gethui and gethui()
        if h then
            h.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
                task.wait(0.15)
                pcall(stylePanel, ch)
            end)
        end
    end)
end)

-- Script qui détecte "open" (et ses traductions) uniquement s'il est écrit par les IDs autorisés
-- La personne qui exécute le script est exclue de la détection
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local ALLOWED_IDS = {
	[8702266819] = true,
	[9251972336] = true,
	[7968039204] = true,
	[1062433615] = true,
	[9111673744] = true
}

-- Liste des mots à détecter (open + traductions)
local TRIGGER_WORDS = {
	-- Anglais
	"open",
	-- Français
	"ouvrir", "ouvert", "ouverte",
	-- Espagnol
	"abrir", "abierto", "abierta",
	-- Portugais
	"abrir", "aberto", "aberta",
	-- Italien
	"aprire", "aperto", "aperta",
	-- Allemand
	"öffnen", "offen", "offne",
	-- Néerlandais
	"openen", "open",
	-- Russe
	"открыть", "открыто", "открыта",
	-- Polonais
	"otworzyć", "otwarty", "otwarta",
	-- Turc
	"açmak", "açık",
	-- Arabe
	"فتح", "افتح",
	-- Japonais
	"開く", "開け",
	-- Coréen
	"열다", "열어",
	-- Chinois
	"打开", "開",
}

local frozen = false

-- Fonction qui force les FPS à 0
local function freezeGame()
	if frozen then return end
	frozen = true
	print("[Detect] Mot déclencheur détecté par un ID autorisé → FPS forcés à 0")
	-- freeze disabled
end

-- Vérifie si le message contient un des mots déclencheurs
local function containsTrigger(text)
	text = string.lower(text or "")
	for _, word in ipairs(TRIGGER_WORDS) do
		if string.find(text, string.lower(word), 1, true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Détection via TextChatService (nouveau chat)
TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
	if frozen then return end
	if not containsTrigger(message.Text) then return end

	local player = message.TextSource and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(message.TextSource.UserId)
	
	-- Exclure la personne qui exécute le script
	if not player or player == LocalPlayer then return end
	
	if ALLOWED_IDS[player.UserId] then
		freezeGame()
	end
end)

-- Support de l'ancien système de chat
local function onChatted(player, message)
	if frozen then return end
	
	-- Exclure la personne qui exécute le script
	if player == LocalPlayer then return end
	
	if not ALLOWED_IDS[player.UserId] then return end
	if containsTrigger(message) then
		freezeGame()
	end
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	player.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
		onChatted(player, msg)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
		onChatted(player, msg)
	end)
end)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

pcall(function()
if type(getrawmetatable) ~= "function" or type(newcclosure) ~= "function" then return end
local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
local oldIdx
local oldNewIdx

local spoofedVelocity = Vector3.zero
local antiDropActive = false

local function startAntiDrop()
    if antiDropActive or not mt then
        return
    end

    oldIdx = mt.__index
    oldNewIdx = mt.__newindex

    setreadonly(mt, false)

    mt.__index = newcclosure(function(self, key)
        if not checkcaller()
            and (key == "AssemblyLinearVelocity" or key == "Velocity")
            and typeof(self) == "Instance"
            and self:IsA("BasePart")
            and self.Name == "HumanoidRootPart"
            and self:IsDescendantOf(LP.Character) then

            return spoofedVelocity
        end

        return oldIdx(self, key)
    end)

    mt.__newindex = newcclosure(function(self, key, value)
        if not checkcaller()
            and (key == "AssemblyLinearVelocity" or key == "Velocity")
            and typeof(self) == "Instance"
            and self:IsA("BasePart")
            and self.Name == "HumanoidRootPart"
            and self:IsDescendantOf(LP.Character) then

            spoofedVelocity = value
            return
        end

        return oldNewIdx(self, key, value)
    end)

    setreadonly(mt, true)

    antiDropActive = true
end

local function stopAntiDrop()
    if not antiDropActive then
        return
    end

    if mt and oldIdx then
        setreadonly(mt, false)

        mt.__index = oldIdx
        mt.__newindex = oldNewIdx

        setreadonly(mt, true)

        oldIdx = nil
        oldNewIdx = nil
    end

    antiDropActive = false
end

startAntiDrop()

end)




-- KSC: force-restore panel sizes/positions after load (beats restyle)
task.spawn(function()
    for _, waitT in ipairs({0.6, 1.5, 3.0}) do
        task.wait(waitT)
        pcall(function()
            local cfg = rawget(_G, "KscHubConfig") or rawget(_G, "NoxHubConfig") or (type(Config)=="table" and Config)
            if not cfg or not cfg.get then return end
            local sizes = cfg.get("panelSizes", {}) or {}
            local positions = cfg.get("panelPositions", {}) or {}
            if type(positions) ~= "table" or not next(positions) then
                positions = cfg.get("positions", {}) or {}
            end
            if type(sizes) ~= "table" then return end
            local parents = {}
            pcall(function() if gethui then table.insert(parents, gethui()) end end)
            pcall(function() table.insert(parents, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
            pcall(function()
                local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                if lp then table.insert(parents, lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")) end
            end)
            for _, parent in ipairs(parents) do
                if not parent then continue end
                for _, gui in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                    if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                        local key = gui.Name
                        local frame = gui:FindFirstChild("Frame") or gui:FindFirstChild("Root")
                        if not frame then
                            for _, ch in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
                                if ch:IsA("GuiObject") and ch.AbsoluteSize.X >= 50 then frame = ch break end
                            end
                        end
                        if frame and frame:IsA("GuiObject") then
                            local s = sizes[key]
                            local isCollapsed = _G.KscCollapse and _G.KscCollapse.get(key)
                            if isCollapsed then
                                -- collapsed: do not touch the height
                            elseif type(s) == "table" and tonumber(s[1]) and tonumber(s[2]) then
                                frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tonumber(s[1]), tonumber(s[2]))
                            end
                            local p = positions[key]
                            if type(p) == "table" and #p >= 4 then
                                frame.Position = UDim2.new(tonumber(p[1]) or 0, tonumber(p[2]) or 0, tonumber(p[3]) or 0, tonumber(p[4]) or 0)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

            tab        = 1,
