        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        local CONFIG_FILE = "KscHub/semi_tp.json"
        local loadedConfig = nil

        local function loadConfig()
            local success, data = pcall(function()
                local raw = readfile(CONFIG_FILE)
                return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
            end)
            if success and data then
                loadedConfig = data
                for k, v in pairs(data) do
                    if k ~= "mainPos" and k ~= "statsPos" and k ~= "launchPos" then
                        state[k] = v
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        loadConfig()

        local win, statsFrame, launchBtn

        local function saveConfig()
            local data = {
                targetSlot = state.targetSlot,
                autoPotion = state.autoPotion,
                pushWalk   = state.pushWalk,
                speedBoost = state.speedBoost,
                giantSpeed = state.giantSpeed,
                aimbot     = state.aimbot,
                espAllowed = state.espAllowed,
                espTimer   = state.espTimer,
                espPlayer  = state.espPlayer,
                speedVal   = state.speedVal,
                giantVal   = state.giantVal,
                mainPos = win and {
                    XScale  = win.Position.X.Scale,
                    XOffset = win.Position.X.Offset,
                    YScale  = win.Position.Y.Scale,
                    YOffset = win.Position.Y.Offset,
                } or nil,
                statsPos = statsFrame and {
                    XScale  = statsFrame.Position.X.Scale,
                    XOffset = statsFrame.Position.X.Offset,
                    YScale  = statsFrame.Position.Y.Scale,
                    YOffset = statsFrame.Position.Y.Offset,
                } or nil,
                launchPos = launchBtn and {
                    XScale  = launchBtn.Position.X.Scale,
                    XOffset = launchBtn.Position.X.Offset,
                    YScale  = launchBtn.Position.Y.Scale,
                    YOffset = launchBtn.Position.Y.Offset,
                } or nil,
            }
            pcall(function()
                writefile(CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
            end)
        end

        local function findTool(name)
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then return nil end
            for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name:lower():find(name:lower()) then return tool end
            end
            for _, tool in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
                if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name:lower():find(name:lower()) then return tool end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function isMyPlot(plot)
            if not plot then return false end
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            if sign then
                local yourBase = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
                if yourBase and yourBase:IsA("BillboardGui") and yourBase.Enabled then return true end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function isValidStealPrompt(prompt)
            if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then return false end
            local stateAttr = prompt:GetAttribute("State")
            local actionText = prompt.ActionText
            return stateAttr == "Steal" or stateAttr == "Grab" or actionText == "Steal" or actionText == "Grab"
        end

        local function isEnemyPlot(plot)
            if not plot or not plot:IsA("Model") then return false end
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            local sg = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
            local frame = sg and sg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
            local label = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
            if not label then return false end
            if label.Text == "Empty Base" then return false end
            local owner = label.Text:gsub("'s [Bb]ase$", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            return owner ~= LocalPlayer.Name and owner ~= LocalPlayer.DisplayName
        end

        local function getClosestEnemyPlot()
            local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return nil end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local myPos = root and root.Position or Vector3.zero
            local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                if isEnemyPlot(plot) then
                    local pos = plot:GetPivot().Position
                    local d = (pos - myPos).Magnitude
                    if d < bestDist then
                        bestDist = d
                        best = plot
                    end
                end
            end
            return best
        end

        local function getBaseSide(plot)
            if not plot then return "left" end
            local plotPos = plot:GetPivot().Position
            local dLeft = (plotPos - BASES.b2.refVec).Magnitude
            local dRight = (plotPos - BASES.b1.refVec).Magnitude
            return (dLeft < dRight) and "left" or "right"
        end

        local STEAL_DURATION = 1.4
        local AutoGrabData = {}

        local function findNearestAutoGrabPrompt()
            local slot = SLOTS[CURRENT_SLOT]
            if not slot then return nil end
            local config = slot[currentSide]
            if not config or not config.GRAB_POS then return nil end
            local targetPos = config.GRAB_POS
            currentGrabPos = targetPos
            local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return nil end
            local nearest, dist = nil, math.huge
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                if not isMyPlot(plot) then
                    local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                    if pods then
                        for _, pod in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                            local base = pod:FindFirstChild("Base")
                            if base then
                                local sp = base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                                if sp then
                                    local d = (sp.Position - targetPos).Magnitude
                                    if d <= 15 and d < dist then
                                        local att = sp:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                                        if att then
                                            for _, p in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
                                                if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and isValidStealPrompt(p) then
                                                    nearest, dist = p, d
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nearest
        end

        local function executeAutoGrab(prompt)
            if autoGrabStealing then return end
            if not AutoGrabData[prompt] then
                AutoGrabData[prompt] = { hold = {}, trigger = {}, ready = true }
                if getconnections then
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
                        if c.Function then table.insert(AutoGrabData[prompt].hold, c.Function) end
                    end
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
                        if c.Function then table.insert(AutoGrabData[prompt].trigger, c.Function) end
                    end
                end
            end
            local data = AutoGrabData[prompt]
            if not data.ready then return end
            data.ready = false
            autoGrabStealing = true
            local startTime = tick()
            task.spawn(function()
                for _, f in ipairs(data.hold) do pcall(f) end
                while tick() - startTime < STEAL_DURATION do
                    local progress = math.clamp((tick() - startTime) / STEAL_DURATION, 0, 1)
                    currentProgress = progress
                    task.wait()
                end
                for _, f in ipairs(data.trigger) do pcall(f) end
                task.wait(0.05)
                currentProgress = 0
                data.ready = true
                autoGrabStealing = false
            end)
        end

        local function stopEverything()
            isMoving = false
            autoGrabEnabled = false
            currentProgress = 0
            waitingOnSecondLast = false
            hasStartedMoving = false
            currentPathIndex = 1
            activeStartMoveAt = 0
            activateTime = 0
            grabDelayUntil = 0
            currentTargetPos = nil
            currentSkipTeleport = false
            currentGrabPos = nil
            autoTPCooldownUntil = tick() + 3
            if currentMovement then pcall(function() currentMovement:Disconnect() end) currentMovement = nil end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if root then
                    local v = root:FindFirstChild("LinearVelocity") if v then v:Destroy() end
                    local a = root:FindFirstChild("Attachment") if a then a:Destroy() end
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then hum:UnequipTools() end
            end
        end

        local CLOSE_THRESHOLD = 10

        local function startPath()
            if isMoving or not LocalPlayer.Character then return end
            local slot = SLOTS[CURRENT_SLOT]
            if not slot then return end

            local enemyPlot = getClosestEnemyPlot()
            currentSide = getBaseSide(enemyPlot)
            local config = slot[currentSide]
            if not config or not config.PATH then return end

            isMoving = true
            autoGrabEnabled = true
            currentProgress = 0
            waitingOnSecondLast = false
            hasStartedMoving = false
            activateTime = tick()
            currentSkipTeleport = false
            useGiantPotion = state.autoPotion  -- linked to toggle

            local SPEED = 160
            local PATH = config.PATH
            currentGrabPos = config.GRAB_POS

            local root = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return end

            local closestIndex = 1
            local closestDist = math.huge
            for i, point in ipairs(PATH) do
                local d = (point.pos - root.Position).Magnitude
                if d < closestDist then
                    closestDist = d
                    closestIndex = i
                end
            end

            local thirdLastIndex = math.max(1, #PATH - 2)
            local distToThirdLast = (PATH[thirdLastIndex].pos - root.Position).Magnitude
            currentPathIndex = closestIndex
            if closestIndex > thirdLastIndex and distToThirdLast > CLOSE_THRESHOLD then
                currentPathIndex = thirdLastIndex
            elseif closestIndex == #PATH then
                currentPathIndex = math.max(1, #PATH - 1)
            end

            activeStartMoveAt = PATH[currentPathIndex].START_MOVE_AT or 0

            if activeStartMoveAt < 0 then
                grabDelayUntil = activateTime + math.abs(activeStartMoveAt)
            else
                grabDelayUntil = 0
            end

            local Attachment, Velocity
            local STOP_DIST = 3.5
            local PRECISE_DIST = 1.6

            if currentMovement then pcall(function() currentMovement:Disconnect() end) end

            currentMovement = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not char then stopEverything() return end
                local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then stopEverything() return end

                if waitingOnSecondLast and currentProgress >= TELEPORT_AT then
                    if not currentSkipTeleport then
                        local lastPos = PATH[#PATH].pos
                        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastPos)
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        if Velocity then Velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero end

                        if useGiantPotion then
                            task.spawn(function()
                                local potion = findTool("giant potion") or findTool("giant")
                                if potion then
                                    hum:UnequipTools()
                                    task.wait(0.03)
                                    hum:EquipTool(potion)
                                    task.wait(0.05)
                                    pcall(function() potion:Activate() end)
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    stopEverything()
                    -- Push walk to base if enabled
                    if state.pushWalk then
                        task.spawn(function()
                            local targetHitbox = getNearestDeliveryHitbox()
                            if targetHitbox then
                                local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                if hrp then walkToAnti(hrp, targetHitbox, getAutoWalkSpeed(), 3, 6) end
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    return
                end

                if waitingOnSecondLast then
                    if Velocity then Velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero end
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    return
                end

                if not hasStartedMoving then
                    local elapsed = tick() - activateTime
                    local canStart = (activeStartMoveAt <= 0) or (elapsed >= activeStartMoveAt)
                    if canStart then
                        hasStartedMoving = true
                        local carpet = findTool("flying carpet") or findTool("carpet")
                        if carpet then
                            hum:UnequipTools()
                            task.wait(0.03)
                            hum:EquipTool(carpet)
                        end

                        if root:FindFirstChild("LinearVelocity") then root.LinearVelocity:Destroy() end
                        if root:FindFirstChild("Attachment") then root.Attachment:Destroy() end
                        Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
                        Attachment.Parent = root
                        Velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
                        Velocity.Attachment0 = Attachment
                        Velocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
                        Velocity.MaxForce = 50000
                        Velocity.Parent = root
                    else
                        return
                    end
                end

                if not Velocity or not Velocity.Parent then return end

                local targetEntry = PATH[currentPathIndex]
                if not targetEntry then stopEverything() return end
                local target = targetEntry.pos

                local dir = target - root.Position
                local dist = dir.Magnitude
                local stopDist = (currentPathIndex >= #PATH - 1) and PRECISE_DIST or STOP_DIST

                if dist <= stopDist then
                    Velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(target)

                    if currentPathIndex >= #PATH - 1 then
                        waitingOnSecondLast = true
                        return
                    end

                    currentPathIndex = currentPathIndex + 1
                    if currentPathIndex > #PATH then stopEverything() return end
                    return
                end

                local speedMult = dist < 12 and math.max(0.15, dist / 12) or 1
                Velocity.VectorVelocity = dir.Unit * SPEED * speedMult
            end)
        end

        -- Auto-grab loop
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not autoGrabEnabled or autoGrabStealing then return end
            if tick() < grabDelayUntil then return end
            local ok, prompt = pcall(findNearestAutoGrabPrompt)
            if ok and prompt then pcall(executeAutoGrab, prompt) end
        end)

        -- ==========================================
        -- PUSH WALK HELPERS 
        -- ==========================================
        local function walkToAnti(HRP, targetPos, speed, arriveDist, timeout)
            if not HRP or not HRP.Parent or not targetPos then return end
            speed = speed or 28
            arriveDist = arriveDist or 6
            timeout = timeout or 6

            local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
            attachment.Parent = HRP

            local linearVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
            linearVelocity.MaxForce = 100000
            linearVelocity.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
            linearVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
            linearVelocity.Attachment0 = attachment
            linearVelocity.Parent = HRP

            local start = tick()
            while HRP and HRP.Parent do
                local d = targetPos - HRP.Position
                local flat = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
                local mag = flat.Magnitude
                if mag < arriveDist or tick() - start > timeout then break end
                local dir = flat.Unit
                linearVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * speed, 0, dir.Z * speed)
                task.wait()
            end

            linearVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
            linearVelocity:Destroy()
            attachment:Destroy()

            if HRP and HRP.Parent then HRP.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero end
        end

        local function getNearestDeliveryHitbox()
            local myBase = nil
            local plots = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if plots then
                for _, base in pairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                    if base:IsA("Model") then
                        for _, d in pairs(base:GetDescendants()) do
                            if d:IsA("TextLabel") and (string.find(d.Text, LocalPlayer.Name) or string.find(d.Text, LocalPlayer.DisplayName)) then
                                myBase = base
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if myBase then break end
                end
            end
            if not myBase then return nil end
            local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local refPos = hrp and hrp.Position or myBase:GetPivot().Position
            local nearestPos = nil
            local minDist = math.huge
            for _, d in pairs(myBase:GetDescendants()) do
                if d.Name == "DeliveryHitbox" then
                    local pos = d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Position or (d:IsA("Model") and d:GetPivot().Position)
                    if pos then
                        local dist = (pos - refPos).Magnitude
                        if dist < minDist then
                            minDist = dist
                            nearestPos = pos
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nearestPos
        end

        local function getAutoWalkSpeed()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local isGiant = hrp and hrp.Size.Y > 2.5
            local giantAttr = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Giant") end) and LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Giant") == true
            if giantAttr then isGiant = true end
            if state.giantSpeed and isGiant then
                return tonumber(state.giantVal) or 34
            end
            local stealing = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") end) and LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true
            if state.speedBoost and stealing then
                return tonumber(state.speedVal) or 29.5
            end
            return 20
        end

        -- ==========================================
        -- HALFWAY STEAL MODULE (exposed to UI)
        -- ==========================================
        local HalfwaySteal = {
            debounce = false,
        }

        function HalfwaySteal.setSlot(slot)
            CURRENT_SLOT = math.clamp(slot, 1, MAX_SLOTS)
            state.targetSlot = CURRENT_SLOT
            saveConfig()
        end

        function HalfwaySteal.execute()
            if HalfwaySteal.debounce then return end
            HalfwaySteal.debounce = true
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(startPath)
                HalfwaySteal.debounce = false
            end)
        end

        function HalfwaySteal.activate()
            task.spawn(function()
                setFFlags()
                doReset()
            end)
        end

        local fflagsApplied = false

        local function setFFlags()
            if fflagsApplied then return end
            if type(setfflag) ~= "function" then return end
            for name, value in pairs(FFlags) do
                pcall(function() setfflag(tostring(name), tostring(value)) end)
            end
            fflagsApplied = true
        end

        local resetCooldown = false
        local resetThread = nil
        local currentCharacter = nil
        local resetSuccessful = false
        local stopResetSequence = false
        local cameraLocked = false
        local lockedCameraCFrame = nil

        local function ResetPlayer()
            if resetCooldown then return end
            resetCooldown = true
            resetSuccessful = false
            stopResetSequence = false
            cameraLocked = false

            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not character then resetCooldown = false return end

            local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not humanoid then resetCooldown = false return end

            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if camera then
                lockedCameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
                cameraLocked = true
                camera.CFrame = lockedCameraCFrame
            end

            currentCharacter = character
            local isRespawning = false

            resetThread = task.spawn(function()
                local attempts = 0
                local maxAttempts = 40
                local originalHipHeight = humanoid.HipHeight

                while character and character.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not isRespawning and not stopResetSequence do
                    if LocalPlayer.Character ~= character then
                        isRespawning = true
                        break
                    end

                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid.HipHeight = 1e30
                        humanoid.AutoRotate = true

                        local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if rootPart then
                            rootPart.CanCollide = false
                        end

                        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                                part.CanCollide = false
                            end
                        end
                    end)

                    if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or LocalPlayer.Character ~= character then
                        resetSuccessful = true
                        break
                    end

                    attempts = attempts + 1
                    if attempts >= maxAttempts then break end
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end

                if not resetSuccessful then
                    if character and character.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not isRespawning then
                        pcall(function()
                            humanoid.Health = 0
                        end)
                        task.wait(0.1)
                        if not character.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                            resetSuccessful = true
                        end
                    end
                end

                if not resetSuccessful and character and character.Parent and humanoid then
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid.HipHeight = originalHipHeight
                        local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if rootPart then
                            rootPart.CanCollide = true
                        end
                        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                                part.CanCollide = true
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end

                cameraLocked = false
                resetCooldown = false
                resetThread = nil
                currentCharacter = nil
                stopResetSequence = false
            end)
        end

        local function StopResetSequence()
            stopResetSequence = true
            if resetThread then
                task.cancel(resetThread)
                resetThread = nil
            end
            resetCooldown = false
            currentCharacter = nil
            cameraLocked = false

            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            if character then
                local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid then
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid.HipHeight = 2
                        local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if rootPart then
                            rootPart.CanCollide = true
                        end
                        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                                part.CanCollide = true
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            StopResetSequence()
            resetCooldown = false
            currentCharacter = nil
            resetSuccessful = false
            stopResetSequence = false
            cameraLocked = false
        end)

        task.spawn(function()
            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            while true do
                task.wait(0.016)
                if cameraLocked and lockedCameraCFrame and camera then
                    camera.CFrame = lockedCameraCFrame
                end
            end
        end)

        local function doReset()
            ResetPlayer()
        end

        -- ==========================================
        -- SPEED BOOST 
        -- ==========================================
        local GIANT_THRESHOLD = 2.5

        local function isCarryingBrainrot(char)
            if not char then return false end
            local ok, stealing = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Stealing") end)
            if ok and stealing == true then return true end
            local ok2, anticarry = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("AntiKick") end)
            if ok2 and anticarry == true then return true end
            for _, name in ipairs({"Carrying", "IsCarrying", "Grabbed", "Holding", "StealHold", "HasGrab"}) do
                local v = char:FindFirstChild(name, true)
                if v then
                    if v:IsA("BoolValue") and v.Value then return true end
                    if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Value then return true end
                    if v:IsA("StringValue") and v.Value ~= "" then return true end
                end
            end
            for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Model") and child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
                    local n = child.Name:lower()
                    if n:find("brainrot") or n:find("animal") or n:find("carry") or
                       n:find("grab") or n:find("steal") or n:find("hold") then
                        return true
                    end
                elseif child:IsA("Tool") then
                    local n = child.Name:lower()
                    if not (n:find("bat") or n:find("slap") or n:find("medusa") or n:find("head") or n:find("stone")) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local speedConnection = nil

        local function applySpeedBoost()
            if speedConnection then
                speedConnection:Disconnect()
                speedConnection = nil
            end
            if not state.speedBoost and not state.giantSpeed then return end

            speedConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not char then return end
                local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hrp or not hum then return end

                local humanoidState = hum:GetState()
                if hum.PlatformStand or humanoidState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or
                   humanoidState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or humanoidState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
                    return
                end

                local isGiant = hrp.Size.Y > GIANT_THRESHOLD
                local giantAttr = pcall(function() return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Giant") end) and LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Giant") == true
                if giantAttr then isGiant = true end

                local spd = nil
                if isGiant then
                    if state.giantSpeed then
                        spd = tonumber(state.giantVal) or 34
                    end
                else
                    if state.speedBoost and isCarryingBrainrot(char) then
                        spd = tonumber(state.speedVal) or 29.5
                    end
                end

                if spd and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    local lv = hrp:FindFirstChild("KaiSpeedLV")
                    if not lv then
                        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
                        att.Name = "KaiSpeedAtt"
                        att.Parent = hrp

                        lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
                        lv.Name = "KaiSpeedLV"
                        lv.Attachment0 = att
                        lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
                        lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
                        lv.MaxAxesForce = Vector3.new(100000, 0, 100000)
                        lv.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
                        lv.Parent = hrp
                    end

                    local md = hum.MoveDirection
                    lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(md.X * spd, 0, md.Z * spd)
                    lv.Enabled = true
                else
                    local lv = hrp and hrp:FindFirstChild("KaiSpeedLV")
                    if lv then lv.Enabled = false end
                end
            end)
        end

        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.3)
            if state.speedBoost or state.giantSpeed then applySpeedBoost() end
        end)

        -- ==========================================
        -- AIMBOT 
        -- ==========================================
        local RealUseItem = nil
        local toolConnections = {}
        local aimbotCharacterConn = nil
        local aimbotActive = false

        local function findRealUseItem()
            if RealUseItem then return end
            local Packages = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            if not Packages then return end
            local NetFolder = Packages:FindFirstChild("Net")
            if not NetFolder then return end
            local gc = debug.getconstants or getconstants
            if not gc then return end
            for _, r in ipairs(NetFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") and not RealUseItem then
                    local ok, conns = pcall(getconnections, r.OnClientEvent)
                    if ok and conns then
                        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
                            if type(c.Function) == "function" then
                                local okc, consts = pcall(gc, c.Function)
                                if okc then
                                    for _, k in ipairs(consts) do
                                        if k == "PaintballHitted" then
                                            RealUseItem = r
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if RealUseItem then break end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function getClosestHRP()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return nil end
            local closestHRP, closestDist = nil, math.huge
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                    local tHRP = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if tHRP then
                        local d = (hrp.Position - tHRP.Position).Magnitude
                        if d < closestDist then
                            closestDist = d
                            closestHRP = tHRP
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return closestHRP
        end

        local validTools = {
            ["Laser Cape"] = true,
            ["Paintball Gun"] = true,
            ["Web Slinger"] = true,
            ["Body Swap Potion"] = true,
        }

        local function connectTool(tool)
            if not tool or not validTools[tool.Name] then return end
            if toolConnections[tool] then return end
            local conn = tool.Activated:Connect(function()
                if not RealUseItem then findRealUseItem() end
                if not RealUseItem then return end
                local closestHRP = getClosestHRP()
                if closestHRP then
                    pcall(function() RealUseItem:FireServer(closestHRP.Position, closestHRP) end)
                end
            end)
            toolConnections[tool] = conn
        end

        local function onCharacter(char)
            for _, existingTool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if existingTool:IsA("Tool") then connectTool(existingTool) end
            end
            char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if child:IsA("Tool") then connectTool(child) end
            end)
            char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
                if child:IsA("Tool") and toolConnections[child] then
                    toolConnections[child]:Disconnect()
                    toolConnections[child] = nil
                end
            end)
        end

        local function enableAimbot()
            if aimbotActive then return end
            aimbotActive = true
            findRealUseItem()
            if LocalPlayer.Character then onCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character) end
            aimbotCharacterConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
        end

        local function disableAimbot()
            aimbotActive = false
            if aimbotCharacterConn then aimbotCharacterConn:Disconnect(); aimbotCharacterConn = nil end
            for tool, conn in pairs(toolConnections) do conn:Disconnect() end
            toolConnections = {}
        end

        -- ==========================================
        -- ESPs 
        -- ==========================================
        local TimerESP = { enabled = false, pool = {}, gui = nil, conn = nil }

        local function findBasePartAncestor(obj)
            while obj and not obj:IsA("BasePart") do
                obj = obj.Parent
                if obj and obj:IsA("Model") then
                    local p = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    if p then return p end
                end
            end
            if obj and obj:IsA("BasePart") then return obj end
            return nil
        end

        function TimerESP:setEnabled(v)
            self.enabled = v
            if not v then
                for _, e in pairs(self.pool) do if e.bb then e.bb.Enabled = false end end
            end
            if not self.gui then
                local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
                g.Name = "TimerESP"
                g.ResetOnSpawn = false
                g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                g.Parent = CoreGui
                self.gui = g
            end
        end

        function TimerESP:getBoard(plot, ad)
            local e = self.pool[plot]
            if not e then
                local isMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
                local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                bb.Name = "TimerESP"
                bb.Size = isMobile and UDim2.new(0,84,0,21) or UDim2.new(0,140,0,36)
                bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,1.5,0)
                bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
                bb.LightInfluence = 0
                bb.MaxDistance = math.huge
                bb.Enabled = false
                bb.Parent = self.gui
                local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                lbl.TextSize = isMobile and 12 or 22
                lbl.Text = ""
                lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
                lbl.Parent = bb
                e = { bb = bb, lbl = lbl }
                self.pool[plot] = e
            end
            e.bb.Adornee = ad
            return e
        end

        function TimerESP:scan()
            local plotsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plotsFolder then return end
            if not self.enabled then
                for _, e in pairs(self.pool) do if e.bb and e.bb.Enabled then e.bb.Enabled = false end end
                return
            end
            local cache = plotsFolder:GetChildren()
            local activePlots = {}
            for _, plot in ipairs(cache) do
                local bestTimer, bestAnchor, bestY = nil, nil, math.huge
                for _, d in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d.Name == "RemainingTime" and (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextBox")) then
                        local txt = (d.ContentText ~= "" and d.ContentText) or (d.Text ~= "" and d.Text) or nil
                        if txt then
                            local anchor = findBasePartAncestor(d)
                            if anchor then
                                local y = anchor.Position.Y
                                if y < bestY then
                                    bestY, bestTimer, bestAnchor = y, txt, anchor
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if bestTimer and bestAnchor then
                    activePlots[plot] = true
                    local board = self:getBoard(plot, bestAnchor)
                    if board.lbl.Text ~= bestTimer then board.lbl.Text = bestTimer end
                    board.bb.Enabled = true
                end
            end
            for plot, e in pairs(self.pool) do
                if not activePlots[plot] then
                    if e.bb and e.bb.Enabled then e.bb.Enabled = false end
                end
            end
        end

        function TimerESP:startLoop()
            if self.conn then self.conn:Disconnect() end
            local acc = 0
            self.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                acc = acc + dt
                if acc >= 0.3 then acc = 0; self:scan() end
            end)
        end

        function TimerESP:stop()
            if self.conn then self.conn:Disconnect(); self.conn = nil end
            self:setEnabled(false)
            if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy(); self.gui = nil end
            self.pool = {}
        end

        -- Player ESP
        local espPlayerEnabled = false
        local ESPFolder = nil
        local espPlayerConnections = {}
        local espPlayerLoop = nil

        local function getESPFolder()
            if ESPFolder and ESPFolder.Parent then return ESPFolder end
            local sg = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("KaiESP")
            if not sg then
                sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
                sg.Name = "KaiESP"
                sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
                sg.Parent = CoreGui
            end
            local folder = sg:FindFirstChild("ESPStorage")
            if not folder then
                folder = Instance.new("Folder")
                folder.Name = "ESPStorage"
                folder.Parent = sg
            end
            ESPFolder = folder
            return ESPFolder
        end

        local function updatePlayerESP(plr)
            if not espPlayerEnabled or plr == LocalPlayer then return end
            local char = plr.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return end
            local folder = getESPFolder()
            local hl = folder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name.."_HL")
            if not hl then
                hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                hl.Name = plr.Name.."_HL"
                hl.FillColor = PURPLE
                hl.FillTransparency = 0.4
                hl.OutlineColor = PURPLE
                hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
                hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                hl.Parent = folder
            end
            hl.Adornee = char
            local bb = folder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name.."_BB")
            local lbl
            if not bb then
                bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                bb.Name = plr.Name.."_BB"
                bb.Size = UDim2.new(0,80,0,20)
                bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0,3.5,0)
                bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
                bb.LightInfluence = 0
                bb.MaxDistance = 0
                bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
                bb.Parent = folder
                lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
                lbl.Name = "Label"
                lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
                lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                lbl.TextSize = 13
            else
                lbl = bb:FindFirstChild("Label")
            end
            bb.Adornee = hrp
            if lbl then lbl.Text = plr.Name end
        end

        local function removePlayerESP(plr)
            if ESPFolder then
                local hl = ESPFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name.."_HL")
                if hl then hl:Destroy() end
                local bb = ESPFolder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name.."_BB")
                if bb then bb:Destroy() end
            end
        end

        local function setupEspPlayerListeners()
            for _, c in ipairs(espPlayerConnections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            espPlayerConnections = {}
            local function onPlayerAdded(plr)
                local conn = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5); updatePlayerESP(plr) end)
                table.insert(espPlayerConnections, conn)
                updatePlayerESP(plr)
            end
            local addedConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
            local removedConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removePlayerESP)
            table.insert(espPlayerConnections, addedConn)
            table.insert(espPlayerConnections, removedConn)
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if plr ~= LocalPlayer then onPlayerAdded(plr) end end
        end

        local function enableEspPlayer()
            espPlayerEnabled = true
            setupEspPlayerListeners()
            if espPlayerLoop then espPlayerLoop:Disconnect() end
            espPlayerLoop = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if espPlayerEnabled then
                    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do pcall(updatePlayerESP, plr) end
                end
            end)
        end

        local function disableEspPlayer()
            espPlayerEnabled = false
            for _, c in ipairs(espPlayerConnections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            espPlayerConnections = {}
            if espPlayerLoop then espPlayerLoop:Disconnect(); espPlayerLoop = nil end
            if ESPFolder then for _, child in ipairs(ESPFolder:GetChildren()) do child:Destroy() end end
            local sg = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("KaiESP")
            if sg then sg:Destroy() end
        end

        -- Allowed ESP
        local espAllowEnabled = false
        local espAllowConnections = {}

        local function updateProximityPrompt(prompt)
            if not espAllowEnabled then return end
            local parent = prompt.Parent
            if not parent or not parent:IsA("BasePart") then return end
            for _, c in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do if c.Name == "FriendInd" then c:Destroy() end end
            local text = string.lower(prompt.ObjectText or "")
            if not string.find(text, "friends") then return end
            local isAllowed = (text == "allow friends")
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Name = "FriendInd"
            bb.Size = UDim2.new(0,140,0,35)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
            bb.ExtentsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2,0)
            bb.Parent = parent
            local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
            lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            lbl.TextSize = 14
            lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
            lbl.Text = isAllowed and "❌ DISALLOWED" or "✅ ALLOWED"
            lbl.TextColor3 = isAllowed and Color3.fromRGB(252,3,3) or Color3.fromRGB(26,255,0)
        end

        local function scanAllPrompts()
            if not espAllowEnabled then
                for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do if obj.Name == "FriendInd" then obj:Destroy() end end
                return
            end
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then updateProximityPrompt(obj) end
            end
        end

        local function setupPromptListeners(prompt)
            if not espAllowEnabled then return end
            updateProximityPrompt(prompt)
            local conn = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ObjectText"):Connect(function() updateProximityPrompt(prompt) end)
            table.insert(espAllowConnections, conn)
        end

        local function enableEspAllow()
            espAllowEnabled = true
            for _, c in ipairs(espAllowConnections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            espAllowConnections = {}
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then setupPromptListeners(obj) end
            end
            local addedConn = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then task.wait(0.1); setupPromptListeners(obj) end
            end)
            table.insert(espAllowConnections, addedConn)
            scanAllPrompts()
        end

        local function disableEspAllow()
            espAllowEnabled = false
            for _, c in ipairs(espAllowConnections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            espAllowConnections = {}
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do if obj.Name == "FriendInd" then obj:Destroy() end end
        end

        -- ==========================================
        -- TOGGLE HELPER (for UI)
        -- ==========================================
        local function toggleAction(key, on)
            if key == "speedBoost" or key == "giantSpeed" then
                applySpeedBoost()
            elseif key == "aimbot" then
                if on then enableAimbot() else disableAimbot() end
            elseif key == "espTimer" then
                if on then TimerESP:setEnabled(true); TimerESP:startLoop() else TimerESP:stop() end
            elseif key == "espPlayer" then
                if on then enableEspPlayer() else disableEspPlayer() end
            elseif key == "espAllowed" then
                if on then enableEspAllow() else disableEspAllow() end
            end
        end

        -- ==========================================
        -- GUI CONSTRUCTION (unchanged, but slot counter max 18)
        -- ==========================================
        local function make(class, parent)
            local obj = Instance.new(class)
            obj.Parent = parent
            return obj
        end

        local function addCorner(radius, parent)
            local c = make("UICorner", parent)
            c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
        end

        local function addAnimatedStroke(parent, thickness)
            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            stroke.Thickness = thickness or 1
            stroke.Color = PURPLE
            stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            stroke.Parent = parent
            local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, LIGHT_PURPLE),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, DARK_PURPLE),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, LIGHT_PURPLE),
            })
            grad.Parent = stroke
            task.spawn(function()
                local a = 0
                while grad and grad.Parent do
                    a = (a + 4) % 360
                    grad.Rotation = a
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
            end)
            return stroke
        end

        local function switchTab(i)
            state.tab = i
            page1.Visible = i == 1
            page2.Visible = i == 2
            for j, btn in pairs(tabBtns) do
                local isActive = j == i
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = isActive and MEDIUM_PURPLE or BG_COLOR
                btn.BackgroundTransparency = isActive and 0 or 1
                btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
            end
        end


        local function counterRow(parent, label, order, initVal, minVal, maxVal)
            local row = make("Frame", parent)
            row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
            row.BackgroundColor3 = ROW_BG
            row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
            row.BorderSizePixel = 0
            row.LayoutOrder = order
            addCorner(10, row)
            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            stroke.Thickness = 1
            stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            stroke.Parent = row

            local rowLayout = make("UIListLayout", row)
            rowLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
            rowLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            rowLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
            rowLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
            rowLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)

            local val = initVal or 1
            local mn = minVal or 1
            local mx = maxVal or 10

            local function makeArrowBtn(txt, lo)
                local b = make("TextButton", row)
                b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                b.Text = txt
                b.TextColor3 = MUTED_COLOR
                b.TextSize = 13
                b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                b.AutoButtonColor = false
                b.LayoutOrder = lo
                addCorner(5, b)
                return b
            end

            local minusBtn = makeArrowBtn("-", 0)

            local lbl = make("TextLabel", row)
            lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            lbl.Text = label .. ": " .. val
            lbl.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
            lbl.TextSize = 9
            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            lbl.LayoutOrder = 1

            local plusBtn = makeArrowBtn("+", 2)

            local function update(n)
                val = math.clamp(n, mn, mx)
                lbl.Text = label .. ": " .. val
                HalfwaySteal.setSlot(val)
                saveConfig()
            end

            minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() update(val - 1) end)
            plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() update(val + 1) end)
        end

        local function toggleRow(parent, label, key, order, inputKey)
            local row = make("Frame", parent)
            row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
            row.BackgroundColor3 = ROW_BG
            row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
            row.BorderSizePixel = 0
            row.LayoutOrder = order
            addCorner(10, row)

            local rowLabel = make("TextLabel", row)
            rowLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, inputKey and -120 or -52, 1, 0)
            rowLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 0)
            rowLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            rowLabel.Text = label
            rowLabel.TextColor3 = TEXT_COLOR
            rowLabel.TextSize = 9
            rowLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            rowLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

            if inputKey then
                local inp = make("TextBox", row)
                inp.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 16)
                inp.Position = UDim2.new(1, -74, 0.5, -8)
                inp.BackgroundColor3 = INPBG_COLOR
                inp.BorderSizePixel = 0
                inp.Text = state[inputKey]
                inp.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                inp.TextSize = 8
                inp.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                inp.PlaceholderText = state[inputKey]
                inp.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 160)
                inp.ClearTextOnFocus = true
                addCorner(5, inp)
                addAnimatedStroke(inp, 1)

                inp.Focused:Connect(function()
                    inp.PlaceholderText = inp.Text ~= "" and inp.Text or state[inputKey]
                    inp.Text = ""
                end)

                inp.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                    if inp.Text == "" then
                        inp.Text = state[inputKey]
                    else
                        state[inputKey] = inp.Text
                    end
                    inp.PlaceholderText = state[inputKey]
                    if key == "speedBoost" or key == "giantSpeed" then applySpeedBoost() end
                    saveConfig()
                end)
            end

local _KSC_RS = {cooldown = false, lockId = 0, cameraLocked = false, lockedCFrame = nil}
local function _KSC_FixFloating(character)
    if not character or not character.Parent then return end
    pcall(function()
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            if humanoid.HipHeight > 10 or humanoid.HipHeight < 0.5 then
                humanoid.HipHeight = 2
            end
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            humanoid.Sit = false
            humanoid.AutoRotate = true
        end
        local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if rootPart and not rootPart.CanCollide then
            rootPart.CanCollide = true
        end
        for _, joint in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if (joint:IsA("Motor6D") or joint:IsA("Motor")) and not joint.Enabled then
                joint.Enabled = true
            end
        end
    end)
end
local function _KSC_StopReset()
    _KSC_RS.lockId = _KSC_RS.lockId + 1
    _KSC_RS.cooldown = false
    _KSC_RS.cameraLocked = false
    _KSC_RS.lockedCFrame = nil
    _G["bjkInstaResetting"] = false
    local LPl = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local char = LPl.Character
    if char then _KSC_FixFloating(char) end
    pcall(function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum end
        end
    end)
end
pcall(function()
    local LPl = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    LPl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
        _KSC_StopReset()
        task.wait(0.5)
        if newChar and newChar.Parent then _KSC_FixFloating(newChar) end
    end)
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local LPl = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    while true do
        task.wait(1)
        local char = LPl.Character
        local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and (humanoid.HipHeight > 100 or humanoid.HipHeight < 0.1) then
            _KSC_FixFloating(char)
        end
    end
end)
_G["StopResetSequence"] = _KSC_StopReset

-- Instant Reset (version KSC Hub : HipHeight + camera lock)
function instantReset()
    -- (comportement BJK conservé) coupe Auto Buy avant le reset
    pcall(
    function() if _0zJOMMZQKusXT and _0zJOMMZQKusXT.AutoBuyEnabled then
        _0zJOMMZQKusXT["AutoBuyEnabled"] = false
        pcall(saveConfig)
        if toggleAutoBuy then
            pcall(toggleAutoBuy, false)
        elseif _G.toggleAutoBuy then
            pcall(_G.toggleAutoBuy, false)
        end
        pcall(setToggle, "Auto Buy", false)
        pcall(function() if autoBuyActive ~= nil then autoBuyActive = false end end)
        pcall(function() if destroyAutoBuyRing then destroyAutoBuyRing() end end)
        pcall(function()
            local ring = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BJK_AutoBuyRing")
            if ring then ring:Destroy() end
        end)
    end
    end
    )
    _G["_bjkCancelTP"] = true
    _G["RecoveryInProgress"] = false
    _G["_bjkLagbackRecoveryGen"] = (_G._bjkLagbackRecoveryGen or 0) + 1
    if _G.invisibleStealEnabled or animPlaying then
        animPlaying = true
        pcall(invisTurnOff)
    end

    if _KSC_RS.cooldown then return end
    local LPl = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local character = LPl.Character
    if not character then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
    _KSC_RS.cooldown = true
    _G["bjkInstaResetting"] = true
    _G["_instaResetTime"] = os.clock()
    pcall(clearPlayerESP)
    pcall(clearTimerESP)
    pcall(clearBrainrotESP)

    -- pose les tools puis reset
    pcall(function()
        local bp = LPl:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        for _, t in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") then
                pcall(function() t.Parent = workspace end)
                if t.Parent == character then
                    if bp then t.Parent = bp else pcall(function() t:Destroy() end) end
                end
            end
        end
        humanoid:UnequipTools()
    end)
    task.wait(0.05)

    _KSC_RS.lockId = _KSC_RS.lockId + 1
    local myLockId = _KSC_RS.lockId
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if camera and not _KSC_RS.cameraLocked then
        _KSC_RS.lockedCFrame = camera.CFrame
        _KSC_RS.cameraLocked = true
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        camera.CFrame = _KSC_RS.lockedCFrame
    end

    local originalHipHeight = humanoid.HipHeight
    if type(originalHipHeight) ~= "number" or originalHipHeight > 10 or originalHipHeight < 0 then
        originalHipHeight = 2
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local attempts = 0
        while character and character.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and myLockId == _KSC_RS.lockId do
            pcall(function()
                humanoid.HipHeight = 1e30
                humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if root then root.CanCollide = false end
                for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        part.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end)
            attempts = attempts + 1
            if attempts >= 25 then break end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end

        if character and character.Parent and humanoid then
            pcall(function() humanoid.HipHeight = originalHipHeight end)
        end
        if character and character.Parent and myLockId == _KSC_RS.lockId then
            pcall(function()
                humanoid.HipHeight = originalHipHeight
                humanoid.PlatformStand = false
                humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if root then root.CanCollide = true end
                for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        part.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        if myLockId == _KSC_RS.lockId then
            _KSC_RS.cameraLocked = false
            _KSC_RS.lockedCFrame = nil
            pcall(function()
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam then
                    cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                    local newChar = LPl.Character
                    local newHum = newChar and newChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if newHum then cam.CameraSubject = newHum end
                end
            end)
        end
        _KSC_RS.cooldown = false
        _G["bjkInstaResetting"] = false
    end)
    task.delay(12, function() _KSC_RS.cooldown = false; _G["bjkInstaResetting"] = false end)
end
_bjkResetBindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
_bjkResetBindable.Event:Connect(

end

-- ============================================================
-- WAIT CHARACTER READY (condiviso)
-- Al respawn il character esiste prima delle sue parti. Aspettare un
-- tempo fisso e' inaffidabile: qui si aspetta che Head, HumanoidRootPart
-- e Humanoid esistano davvero. Ritorna false se scade il timeout o se il
-- character viene sostituito nel frattempo.
-- ============================================================
function _G._KSC_DUELWaitCharReady(character, timeout)
  character = character or LP.Character
  if not character then return false end
  local deadline = os.clock() + (tonumber(timeout) or 5)
  while os.clock() < deadline do
    if not character.Parent then return false end
    if LP.Character and LP.Character ~= character then return false end
    if character:FindFirstChild("Head")
       and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
       and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
      return true
    end
    task.wait(0.05)
  end
  return false
end
