    table.insert(_proJumpHistory, rawCurVel.Y)
    if #_proJumpHistory > PRO_CFG.MAX_JUMP_HISTORY then table.remove(_proJumpHistory, 1) end
    local accel = Vector3.zero
    if #_proVelHistory >= 3 then
        local newest = _proVelHistory[#_proVelHistory]
        local oldest = _proVelHistory[1]
        accel = (newest - oldest) / math.max(#_proVelHistory * 0.016, 0.016)
    end
    local wasTeleported = false
    if #_proPosHistory >= 2 then
        local delta = _proPosHistory[#_proPosHistory] - _proPosHistory[#_proPosHistory - 1]
        if delta.Magnitude > 12 then
            wasTeleported = true
            _proVelHistory = {}
            _proPosHistory = { curPos }
        end
    end
    local targetVelXZ = Vector3.new(curVel.X, 0, curVel.Z)
    local targetSpeed  = targetVelXZ.Magnitude

        if disc < 0 then
            interceptT = dXZ.Magnitude / mySpeed
        else
            local sq = math.sqrt(disc)
            local t1 = (-ib - sq) / (2 * ia)
            local t2 = (-ib + sq) / (2 * ia)
            if     t1 > 0.001 and t2 > 0.001 then interceptT = math.min(t1, t2)
            elseif t1 > 0.001                  then interceptT = t1
            elseif t2 > 0.001                  then interceptT = t2
            else                                    interceptT = dXZ.Magnitude / mySpeed
            end
        end
    end
    interceptT = math.clamp(interceptT, 0.02, 1.5)
    local pctMult  = math.max(PRO_CFG.PREDICT_PCT / 100, 0.05)
    local leadTime = math.clamp(interceptT * pctMult, 0.02, 1.5)
    local predictedPos
    local isEmergency = false
    if wasTeleported then
        predictedPos = curPos + curVel * math.min(leadTime, 0.08)
    elseif mode == "tp_down" then
        local landX = curPos.X + curVel.X * PRO_CFG.TP_DOWN_PREDICT
        local landZ = curPos.Z + curVel.Z * PRO_CFG.TP_DOWN_PREDICT
        local rp = RaycastParams.new()
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LP.Character}; rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local rr = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(landX, curPos.Y, landZ), Vector3.new(0, -200, 0), rp)
        local gy = rr and rr.Position.Y or curPos.Y
        predictedPos = Vector3.new(landX, gy + 3, landZ)
        isEmergency = true
    elseif mode == "infinite_jump" then
        local jt = PRO_CFG.JUMP_PREDICT
        predictedPos = curPos + Vector3.new(curVel.X * jt * 0.5, -2, curVel.Z * jt * 0.5)
    elseif curVel.Y < -28 then

        local disc   = curVel.Y * curVel.Y - 2 * GRAVITY * math.abs(deltaY)

        predictedPos = Vector3.new(

            curPos.Y + curVel.Y * blendT + 0.5 * GRAVITY * blendT * blendT,

    end
    return predictedPos, isEmergency
end

function startBatSpam()
    if SpamThread then return end
    SpamThread = task.spawn(function()
        while CFG.BatSpam do
            pcall(function()
                local char = LP.Character
                if char then
                    local bat = char:FindFirstChild("bat") or char:FindFirstChild("Bat")
                    if not bat then
                        for _, tool in pairs(LP.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
                            if tool.Name:lower() == "bat" then bat = tool break end
                        end
                    end
                    if bat and bat:IsA("Tool") then
                        bat:Activate()
                        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if hrp then
                            local _, nearDist, _ = findBestPart(hrp)
                            if nearDist and nearDist < 6 then
                                task.wait(0.02)
                                bat:Activate()
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            task.wait(CFG.SpamDelay / 1000)
        end
        SpamThread = nil
    end)
end
function stopBatSpam()
    CFG.BatSpam = false
    SpamThread  = nil
end

function startProBatSpam()
    if ProSpamThread then return end
    ProSpamThread = task.spawn(function()
        while PRO_CFG.BatSpam do
            pcall(function()
                local char = LP.Character
                if char then
                    local bat = char:FindFirstChild("bat") or char:FindFirstChild("Bat")
                    if not bat then
                        for _, tool in pairs(LP.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
                            if tool.Name:lower() == "bat" then bat = tool break end
                        end
                    end
                    if bat and bat:IsA("Tool") then
                        bat:Activate()
                        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if hrp then
                            local closestDist = math.huge
                            for _, plr in Players:GetPlayers() do
                                if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
                                    local tr = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                    if tr then
                                        local d = (tr.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                                        if d < closestDist then closestDist = d end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if closestDist < 6 then
                                task.wait(0.02)
                                bat:Activate()
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            task.wait(PRO_CFG.SpamDelay / 1000)
        end
        ProSpamThread = nil
    end)
end
function stopProBatSpam()
    PRO_CFG.BatSpam = false
    ProSpamThread   = nil
end

function enableAim()
    if proEnabled then
        proEnabled = false
        local char = LP.Character; local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hrp then hrp.Velocity = hrp.Velocity * 0.3; purgeHRP(hrp) end
        if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true end
        if proAngVelc then pcall(function() proAngVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
        cleanProAngVelc(); stopProBatSpam()
    end
    if goodEnabled then
        goodEnabled = false; goodEquippedThisRun = false
        local char = LP.Character; local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hrp then hrp.Velocity = hrp.Velocity * 0.3 end
        if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true end
        if goodAngVelc then pcall(function() goodAngVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
        cleanGoodAngVelc()
    end
    aimEnabled = true; batEquippedThisRun = false
    _velHistory = {}; _posHistory = {}; _intendedVel = Vector3.zero
    _jumpHistory = {}; _infiniteJumpDetected = false; _tpDownDetected = false
    local char = LP.Character; local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then purgeHRP(hrp); setupAngVelc(hrp) end
    if CFG.BatSpam then startBatSpam() end
end
function disableAim()
    aimEnabled = false; batEquippedThisRun = false
    stopBatSpam()
    local char = LP.Character
    local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hrp then hrp.Velocity = hrp.Velocity * 0.3; purgeHRP(hrp) end
    if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true end
    if angVelc then pcall(function() angVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
    cleanAngVelc()
end

function enablePro()
    if aimEnabled then
        aimEnabled = false; batEquippedThisRun = false
        stopBatSpam()
        local char = LP.Character; local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hrp then hrp.Velocity = hrp.Velocity * 0.3; purgeHRP(hrp) end
        if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true end
        if angVelc then pcall(function() angVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
        cleanAngVelc()
    end
    if goodEnabled then
        goodEnabled = false; goodEquippedThisRun = false
        local char = LP.Character; local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hrp then hrp.Velocity = hrp.Velocity * 0.3 end
        if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true end
        if goodAngVelc then pcall(function() goodAngVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
        cleanGoodAngVelc()
    end
    proEnabled = true; proEquippedThisRun = false; proSwingCD = false; _proIntendedVel = Vector3.zero
    _proVelHistory = {}; _proPosHistory = {}; _proJumpHistory = {}
    _proInfJumpDet = false; _proTpDownDet = false; _proPeakY = 0; _proNormalTimer = 0
    local char = LP.Character; local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then purgeHRP(hrp); setupProAngVelc(hrp) end
    if PRO_CFG.BatSpam then startProBatSpam() end
end

    proEnabled = false; proEquippedThisRun = false
    stopProBatSpam()
    local char = LP.Character
    local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true end
    if proAngVelc then pcall(function() proAngVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
    cleanProAngVelc()
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not aimEnabled then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not hum then return end
    purgeHRP(root)
    if not angVelc or not angVelc.Parent then setupAngVelc(root) end
    if not batEquippedThisRun then
        batEquippedThisRun = true
        if not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
            local bp  = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            local bat = bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Bat")
            if bat then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
        end
    end
    local target, dist, bestPart = findBestPart(root)
    if not target then
        hum.AutoRotate = true
        if angVelc then pcall(function() angVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
        return
    end
    local mode = detectInfiniteJump(target)
    local predictedPos, isEmergency = computePredictedPos(root, target, bestPart, mode)
    hum.AutoRotate = false
    pcall(function()
        if not angVelc or not angVelc.Parent then return end
        local dCF = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, predictedPos)
        local rCF = root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(dCF)
        local ax, an = rCF:ToAxisAngle()
        if an > 0.01 then
            angVelc.AngularVelocity = root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(ax) * (an * CFG.TURN_SPEED)
        else
            angVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end)
    local moveDir = predictedPos - root.Position
    local distToTarget = moveDir.Magnitude
    -- منع الطيران والانجذاب من بعيد
    if distToTarget > 38 then
        if angVelc then pcall(function() angVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
        hum.AutoRotate = true
        return
    end
    local hDir    = Vector3.new(moveDir.X, 0, moveDir.Z)
    local speedMult = 1
    if distToTarget > 22 then speedMult = 0.42
    elseif distToTarget > 14 then speedMult = 0.68
    elseif distToTarget > 8 then speedMult = 0.85 end
    local hVel    = hDir.Magnitude > 0.1 and hDir.Unit * (CFG.SPEED * speedMult) or Vector3.zero
    local vVel
    if isEmergency then
        vVel = Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(math.sign(moveDir.Y) * CFG.VERT_SPEED * 0.7, -35, 45), 0)
    elseif math.abs(moveDir.Y) > 0.15 then
        vVel = Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(math.sign(moveDir.Y) * CFG.VERT_SPEED * 0.55, -30, 40), 0)
    else
        vVel = Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0)
    end
    _intendedVel = hVel + vVel
    root.Velocity = _intendedVel
    if hDir.Magnitude > 0.5 and distToTarget < 25 then hum:Move(hDir.Unit, false) end
    if CFG.autoSwing and not swingCD then
        local bat = char:FindFirstChild("Bat")
        if bat and bat:IsA("Tool") then
            swingCD = true
            pcall(function()
                bat:Activate()
                local ev = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                if ev then ev:FireServer() end
            end)
            task.delay(CFG.SWING_COOLDOWN, function() swingCD = false end)
        end
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not proEnabled then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not hum then return end
    purgeHRP(root)
    pcall(function()
        if _G and _G.FR_State then
            _G.FR_State.antiBatEnabled = false; _G.FR_State.bypassAntiBatEnabled = false
        end
    end)
    if not proAngVelc or not proAngVelc.Parent then setupProAngVelc(root) end
    if not proEquippedThisRun then
        proEquippedThisRun = true
        if not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
            local bp  = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            local bat = bp and (bp:FindFirstChild("Bat") or bp:FindFirstChild("bat"))
            if bat then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
        end
    end
    local closestTR, closestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
            local tr = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local h2 = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if tr and h2 and h2.Health > 0 then
                local d = (tr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if d < closestDist then closestDist = d; closestTR = tr end
            end
        end
    end
    if closestTR then
        local mode = detectProInfiniteJump(closestTR)
        local predictedPos, isEmergency = computeProPredictedPos(root, closestTR, mode)
        local fp = predictedPos + closestTR.CFrame.LookVector * PRO_CFG.LOOK_OFFSET
        local look     = fp - root.Position
        local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        hum.AutoRotate = false
        if look.Magnitude > 0.01 and flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then
            local tYaw  = math.deg(math.atan2(-flatLook.X, -flatLook.Z))
            local yawD  = (tYaw - root.Orientation.Y + 180) % 360 - 180
            local tPit  = math.deg(math.atan2(look.Y, flatLook.Magnitude))
            local pitD  = (tPit - root.Orientation.X + 180) % 360 - 180
            local yawR  = math.clamp(math.rad(yawD) * PRO_CFG.TURN_SPEED, -PRO_CFG.MAX_TURN, PRO_CFG.MAX_TURN)
            local pitR  = math.clamp(math.rad(pitD) * PRO_CFG.TURN_SPEED, -PRO_CFG.MAX_TURN, PRO_CFG.MAX_TURN)
            local yRad  = math.rad(root.Orientation.Y)
            local rAxis = Vector3.new(math.cos(yRad), 0, -math.sin(yRad))
            proAngVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, yawR, 0) + (rAxis * pitR)
        else
            proAngVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        local mDir = fp - root.Position
        local hDir = Vector3.new(mDir.X, 0, mDir.Z)
        local hVel = hDir.Magnitude > 0.1 and hDir.Unit * PRO_CFG.SPEED or Vector3.zero
        local vVel
        if isEmergency then
            vVel = Vector3.new(0, math.sign(mDir.Y) * PRO_CFG.VERT_SPEED * 1.4, 0)
        elseif math.abs(mDir.Y) > 0.8 then
            vVel = Vector3.new(0, math.sign(mDir.Y) * PRO_CFG.VERT_SPEED, 0)
        else
            vVel = Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)
        end
        _proIntendedVel = hVel + vVel
        root.Velocity = _proIntendedVel
        if hDir.Magnitude > 0.5 then hum:Move(hDir.Unit, false) end
        if PRO_CFG.autoSwing and not proSwingCD and closestDist <= 8 then
            local bat = char:FindFirstChild("Bat") or char:FindFirstChild("bat")
            if bat and bat:IsA("Tool") then
                proSwingCD = true
                pcall(function()
                    bat:Activate()
                    local ev = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                    if ev then ev:FireServer() end
                end)
                task.delay(PRO_CFG.SWING_COOLDOWN, function() proSwingCD = false end)
            end
        end
    else
        hum.AutoRotate = true
        if proAngVelc then pcall(function() proAngVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not goodEnabled then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not hum then return end
    purgeHRP(root)
    pcall(function()
        if _G and _G.FR_State then
            _G.FR_State.antiBatEnabled = false; _G.FR_State.bypassAntiBatEnabled = false
        end
    end)
    if not goodAngVelc or not goodAngVelc.Parent then setupGoodAngVelc(root) end
    if not goodEquippedThisRun then
        goodEquippedThisRun = true
        if not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
            local bp  = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            local bat = bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Bat")
            if bat then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
        end
    end
    local closestTR, closestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
            local tr = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local h2 = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if tr and h2 and h2.Health > 0 then
                local d = (tr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if d < closestDist then closestDist = d; closestTR = tr end
            end
        end
    end
    if closestTR then
        local _vs     = closestTR.Velocity.Magnitude
        local _dynOff = _vs < 0.1 and 1.5 or GOOD_CFG.LOOK_OFFSET
        local fp       = closestTR.Position + closestTR.CFrame.LookVector * _dynOff
        local look     = fp - root.Position
        local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        hum.AutoRotate = false
        if look.Magnitude > 0.01 and flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then
            local tYaw  = math.deg(math.atan2(-flatLook.X, -flatLook.Z))
            local yawD  = (tYaw - root.Orientation.Y + 180) % 360 - 180
            local tPit  = math.deg(math.atan2(look.Y, flatLook.Magnitude))
            local pitD  = (tPit - root.Orientation.X + 180) % 360 - 180
            local yawR  = math.clamp(math.rad(yawD) * GOOD_TURN_SPEED, -GOOD_MAX_TURN, GOOD_MAX_TURN)
            local pitR  = math.clamp(math.rad(pitD) * GOOD_TURN_SPEED, -GOOD_MAX_TURN, GOOD_MAX_TURN)
            local yRad  = math.rad(root.Orientation.Y)
            local rAxis = Vector3.new(math.cos(yRad), 0, -math.sin(yRad))
            goodAngVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, yawR, 0) + (rAxis * pitR)
        else
            goodAngVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        local mDir = fp - root.Position
        local hDir = Vector3.new(mDir.X, 0, mDir.Z)
        local hVel = hDir.Magnitude > 0.1 and hDir.Unit * GOOD_CFG.SPEED or Vector3.zero
        local vVel = math.abs(mDir.Y) > 0.8
            and Vector3.new(0, math.sign(mDir.Y) * GOOD_CFG.VERT_SPEED, 0)
            or  Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)
        _goodIntendedVel = hVel + vVel; root.Velocity = _goodIntendedVel
        if hDir.Magnitude > 0.5 then hum:Move(hDir.Unit, false) end
        if closestDist <= 5 then
            local bat = char:FindFirstChild("Bat")
            if bat and bat:IsA("Tool") then
                pcall(function()
                    bat:Activate()
                    local ev = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                    if ev then ev:FireServer() end
                end)
            end
        end
    else
        hum.AutoRotate = true
        if goodAngVelc then pcall(function() goodAngVelc.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end) end
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LP.Character
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    if aimEnabled then
        local v = root.Velocity
        if math.abs(v.X) > 350 or math.abs(v.Z) > 350 then root.Velocity = _intendedVel end
        purgeHRP(root)
    elseif proEnabled then
        local v = root.Velocity
        if math.abs(v.X) > 350 or math.abs(v.Z) > 350 then root.Velocity = _proIntendedVel end
        purgeHRP(root)
    elseif goodEnabled then
        local v = root.Velocity
        if math.abs(v.X) > 350 or math.abs(v.Z) > 350 then root.Velocity = _goodIntendedVel end
        purgeHRP(root)
    end
end)

function makeDraggable(frame, handle)
    local dn, ds, sp, di = false, nil, nil, nil
    local draggingActive = false
    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if _G.KSC_DUEL_UILocked then return end
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dn = true; ds = i.Position; sp = frame.Position; draggingActive = false
            i.Changed:Connect(function() if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dn = false; draggingActive = false end end)
        end
    end)
    handle.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then di = i end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if _G.KSC_DUEL_UILocked then return end
        if i == di and dn and ds then
            local delta = i.Position - ds
            -- only start drag after moving 14px so a simple tap still counts as click
            if not draggingActive then
                if delta.Magnitude < 14 then return end
                draggingActive = true
            end
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + delta.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
end

    end
end)



function keyToEnum(n)
    if not n then return nil end
    local ok, kc = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[n] end)
    return ok and kc or nil
end

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, _gpe)
    local isKb = inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
    local isGP = inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
    if not isKb and not isGP then return end
    local kc = keyToEnum(CFG.keybind)
    if kc and inp.KeyCode == kc then
        if aimEnabled then disableAim(); aimEnabled = false else enableAim() end
        updateStrongVisual(); updateProVisual(); updateGoodVisual(); saveUA()
    end
    local pkc = keyToEnum(PRO_CFG.keybind)
    if pkc and inp.KeyCode == pkc then
        if proEnabled then disablePro(); proEnabled = false else enablePro() end
        updateStrongVisual(); updateProVisual(); updateGoodVisual(); savePro()
    end
    local gkc = keyToEnum(GOOD_CFG.keybind)
    if gkc and inp.KeyCode == gkc then
        if goodEnabled then disableGood(); goodEnabled = false else enableGood() end
        updateStrongVisual(); updateProVisual(); updateGoodVisual(); saveGood()
    end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    _G.KSC_DUEL_AimbotPanel_Running = false
    disableAim(); disablePro(); disableGood()
end)

end) end)
end

]====]

function _G.KSC_DUEL_OpenAimbotPanel()
	local src = _G.KSC_DUEL_AIMBOT_PANEL_SRC
	if not src then warn('[KSC_DUEL] Aimbot source missing') return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local fn = (loadstring or load)(src)
		if not fn then error('compile failed') end
		fn()
		if type(_G.KSC_DUEL_AIMBOT_PANEL) == 'function' then
			_G.KSC_DUEL_AIMBOT_PANEL()
		end
	end)
	if not ok then warn('[KSC_DUEL] Aimbot Panel error:', err) end
end

local LANG_LIST = {
	{code="fr", flag="🇫🇷", name="Fra"},{code="en", flag="🇬🇧", name="Eng"},
	{code="es", flag="🇪🇸", name="Esp"},{code="de", flag="🇩🇪", name="Deu"},
	{code="pt", flag="🇵🇹", name="Por"},{code="ja", flag="🇯🇵", name="日本"},
	{code="ar", flag="🇸🇦", name="عرب"},
}
local langCallbacks = {}
function T(key) return (TRANSLATIONS[LANG] or TRANSLATIONS["en"])[key] or key end
function onLangChange(cb) table.insert(langCallbacks,cb) end
function setLang(code) LANG=code; for _,cb in ipairs(langCallbacks) do pcall(cb) end end

local OWNER_NAME = "KSC DUEL"
function addOwnerTag(char)
	if not char then return end; local head=char:WaitForChild("Head",5); if not head then return end
	local old=head:FindFirstChild("KSC_DUELTag"); if old then old:Destroy() end
	local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui",head); bb.Name="KSC_DUELTag"; bb.Size=UDim2.new(0,210,0,32); bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.8,0); bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
	local lbl=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb); lbl.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); lbl.BackgroundTransparency=1; lbl.Text="KSC DUEL 👑"; lbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack; lbl.TextSize=14; lbl.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147); lbl.TextStrokeTransparency=0; lbl.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
end
if LP.Name~=OWNER_NAME then
	local function tryTagOwner(p) if p.Name~=OWNER_NAME then return end; if p.Character then task.spawn(function() task.wait(0.5); addOwnerTag(p.Character) end) end; p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) task.wait(0.5); addOwnerTag(char) end) end
	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do tryTagOwner(p) end; Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(tryTagOwner)
end

local AutoSteal = {
    Enabled = false,
    EnabledV2 = false,
    IsStealing = false,
    Radius = 61,
    Duration = 1.3,
    HalfHoldMin = 1.3,
    HalfFireRange = 9,
    HalfHoldMax = 2.99,
    HalfEntryDelay = 0.25,
    V2HoldPercent = 0.75,

-- AUTO SAVE / LOAD CONFIG
local SAVE_FILE = "KSC_DUELPrimeV2_Config.json"
local UserPanels = {}
function loadAllConfig()
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        if not (isfile and isfile(SAVE_FILE) and readfile) then return nil end
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
    end)
    if ok and type(result) == "table" then return result end
    return nil
end
local _loadedConfig = loadAllConfig()

local isStealing = false
local autoGrabSetDelayRadius = 9
local autoGrabStopTime = 0.96
local autoGrabStopEnabled = true

local autoStealConnection = nil

local progressRadLbl = nil

-- ============================================================
-- FUNCIONES UTILITY
-- ============================================================
function isMyPlotByName(plotName)
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if not plots then return false end
    local plot = plots:FindFirstChild(plotName)
    if not plot then return false end
    local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
    if sign then
        local yb = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
        if yb and yb:IsA("BillboardGui") then
            return yb.Enabled == true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function findNearestPrompt()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return nil, nil end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return nil, nil end
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if not plots then return nil, nil end

    local nearestPrompt, nearestDist, nearestName = nil, math.huge, nil

    for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
        if not isMyPlotByName(plot.Name) then
        local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        if pods then
        for _, pod in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
            pcall(function()
                local base = pod:FindFirstChild("Base")
                local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                if spawn then
                    local dist = (spawn.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < nearestDist and dist <= AutoSteal.Radius then
                        local att = spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                        if att then
                            for _, child in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
                                if child:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and child.ActionText and child.ActionText:lower():find("steal") then
                                    nearestPrompt = child
                                    nearestDist = dist
                                    nearestName = pod.Name
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        end
        end
    end

    return nearestPrompt, nearestName
end

-- ============================================================
-- EXECUTE STEAL
-- ============================================================
function executeSteal(prompt, podName)
    if isStealing then return end

    if not AutoSteal.Data[prompt] then
        AutoSteal.Data[prompt] = { hold = {}, trigger = {}, ready = true }
        pcall(function()
            if getconnections then
                for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
                    if c.Function then table.insert(AutoSteal.Data[prompt].hold, c.Function) end
                end
                for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
                    if c.Function then table.insert(AutoSteal.Data[prompt].trigger, c.Function) end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local data = AutoSteal.Data[prompt]
    if not data.ready then return end
    data.ready = false
    isStealing = true
    AutoSteal.IsStealing = true
    AutoSteal.Waiting = false
    stealStartTime = tick()
    if AutoSteal.StatusLabel then AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "STEALING" end

    if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then
        AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    end
    if AutoSteal.PctLabel then
        AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = "0%"
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        for _, f in ipairs(data.hold) do task.spawn(f) end

        local startTime = tick()
        local duration = AutoSteal.Duration
        local promptFired = false

        if autoGrabStopEnabled then
            while isStealing and AutoSteal.Enabled do
                local elapsed = tick() - startTime
                if elapsed >= autoGrabStopTime then break end
                if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then
                    AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
                end
                if AutoSteal.PctLabel then
                    AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = math.floor(math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1) * 100) .. "%"
                end
                if not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Parent.Parent then break end
                local char = LP.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp and (hrp.Position - prompt.Parent.Parent.Position).Magnitude > AutoSteal.Radius then
                    break
                end
                task.wait()
            end

            local stopProgress = math.clamp(autoGrabStopTime / duration, 0, 1)
            if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then
                AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(stopProgress, 0, 1, 0)
            end
            if AutoSteal.PctLabel then
                AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = math.floor(stopProgress * 100) .. "%"
            end

            local phase2Timeout = math.max(2.99 - autoGrabStopTime - math.max(duration - autoGrabStopTime, 0), 0.05)
            local phase2Start = tick()
            AutoSteal.Waiting = true
            if AutoSteal.StatusLabel then AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "WAITING" end
            if AutoSteal.PctLabel then
                AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = math.floor(stopProgress * 100) .. "% WAIT"
            end

            while isStealing and AutoSteal.Enabled do
                if tick() - phase2Start >= phase2Timeout then
                    if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0) end
                    if AutoSteal.PctLabel then AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = "0%" end
                    data.ready = true
                    isStealing = false
        AutoSteal.IsStealing = false
                    task.wait()
                    local newPrompt, newName = findNearestPrompt()
                    if newPrompt then executeSteal(newPrompt, newName) end
                    return
                end
                if not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Parent.Parent then
                    isStealing = false
        AutoSteal.IsStealing = false
                    if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0) end
                    if AutoSteal.PctLabel then AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = "0%" end
                    data.ready = true
                    return
                end
                local char = LP.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    local dist = (hrp.Position - prompt.Parent.Parent.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist <= autoGrabSetDelayRadius then
                        break
                    elseif dist > AutoSteal.Radius then
                        isStealing = false
        AutoSteal.IsStealing = false
                        if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0) end
                        if AutoSteal.PctLabel then AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = "0%" end
                        data.ready = true
                        return
                    end
                end
                task.wait()
            end

            if isStealing and AutoSteal.Enabled then
                local fillStart = tick()
                local fillDuration = math.max(duration - autoGrabStopTime, 0.05)
                while true do
                    local fp = math.clamp((tick() - fillStart) / fillDuration, 0, 1)
                    if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then
                        AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(stopProgress + fp * (1 - stopProgress), 0, 1, 0)
                    end
                    if AutoSteal.PctLabel then
                        AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = math.floor((stopProgress + fp * (1 - stopProgress)) * 100) .. "%"
                    end
                    if fp >= 1 and not promptFired then
                        promptFired = true
                        pcall(function()
                            for _, f in ipairs(data.trigger) do task.spawn(f) end
                            local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("StealAnimal")
                            if remote and podName then
                                remote:FireServer(podName)
                            end
                            if prompt then
                                prompt:Fire()
                            end
                        end)
                        break
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
        else
            while isStealing and AutoSteal.Enabled do
                local elapsed = tick() - startTime
                local progress = math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1)
                if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(progress, 0, 1, 0) end
                if AutoSteal.PctLabel then AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = math.floor(progress * 100) .. "%" end
                if not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Parent.Parent then break end
                local char = LP.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp and (hrp.Position - prompt.Parent.Parent.Position).Magnitude > AutoSteal.Radius then
                    break
                end
                if elapsed >= duration and not promptFired then
                    promptFired = true
                    pcall(function()
                        for _, f in ipairs(data.trigger) do task.spawn(f) end
                        local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("StealAnimal")
                        if remote and podName then remote:FireServer(podName) end
                        if prompt then prompt:Fire() end
                    end)
                    break
                end
                task.wait()
            end
        end

        if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0) end
        if AutoSteal.PctLabel then AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = "0%" end
        data.ready = true
        isStealing = false
        AutoSteal.IsStealing = false
        AutoSteal.Waiting = false
        stealStartTime = nil
        if AutoSteal.StatusLabel then AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "READY" end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- START / STOP AUTO STEAL
-- ============================================================
function startAutoSteal()
    if autoStealConnection then return end
    autoStealConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not AutoSteal.Enabled or isStealing then return end
        local p, n = findNearestPrompt()
        if p then executeSteal(p, n) end
    end)
end

function stopAutoSteal()
    if autoStealConnection then
        autoStealConnection:Disconnect()
        autoStealConnection = nil
    end
    isStealing = false
    AutoSteal.IsStealing = false
    AutoSteal.Waiting = false
    stealStartTime = nil
    if AutoSteal.StatusLabel then AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "READY" end
    if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then
        TS:Create(AutoSteal.ProgressFill, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0) }):Play()
    end
    if AutoSteal.PctLabel then AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = "0%" end
end


-- ============================================================
-- AUTO STEAL V2 (FTX Auto Steal V3 logic)
-- 1) Hold callbacks for holdMin
-- 2) Park progress at ~75%
-- 3) Wait up to 2s for player to enter fire range, then trigger
-- 4) If timeout, briefly reset and stay on same target
-- Exclusive with V1.
-- ============================================================
local autoStealV2Connection = nil
local v2IsStealing = false
local v2VisualProgress = 0

function stopAutoStealV2()
    AutoSteal.EnabledV2 = false
    v2IsStealing = false
    v2VisualProgress = 0
    if autoStealV2Connection then
        pcall(function() autoStealV2Connection:Disconnect() end)
        autoStealV2Connection = nil
    end
    if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then
        pcall(function()
            AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
        end)
    end
    if AutoSteal.PctLabel then AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = "0%" end
    if AutoSteal.StatusLabel then AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "READY" end
end

function startAutoStealV2()
    if autoStealV2Connection then return end
    -- turn off V1
    if AutoSteal.Enabled then
        AutoSteal.Enabled = false
        pcall(stopAutoSteal)
        if setInstaGrab then pcall(setInstaGrab, false) end
    end
    AutoSteal.EnabledV2 = true
    v2VisualProgress = 0
    if AutoSteal.StatusLabel then AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "V2 READY" end

    autoStealV2Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not AutoSteal.EnabledV2 or v2IsStealing then return end
        local prompt, podName = findNearestPrompt()
        if not prompt then return end
        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        local spawn = prompt.Parent and prompt.Parent.Parent
        if not spawn then return end
        local dist = (hrp.Position - spawn.Position).Magnitude
        if dist > AutoSteal.Radius then return end

        v2IsStealing = true
        AutoSteal.IsStealing = true
        AutoSteal.Waiting = false
        if AutoSteal.StatusLabel then AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "V2 HOLD" end

        task.spawn(function()
            -- build callbacks once
            if not AutoSteal.Data[prompt] then
                AutoSteal.Data[prompt] = { hold = {}, trigger = {}, ready = true }
                pcall(function()
                    if getconnections then
                        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
                            if c.Function then table.insert(AutoSteal.Data[prompt].hold, c.Function) end
                        end
                        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
                            if c.Function then table.insert(AutoSteal.Data[prompt].trigger, c.Function) end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            local data = AutoSteal.Data[prompt]
            if not data or not data.ready then
                v2IsStealing = false
                AutoSteal.IsStealing = false
                return
            end
            data.ready = false

            local holdMin = math.max(AutoSteal.HalfHoldMin or AutoSteal.Duration or 1.3, 0.4)
            local holdPercent = math.clamp(AutoSteal.V2HoldPercent or 0.75, 0.20, 0.75)
            local fireRange = AutoSteal.V2FireRange or AutoSteal.HalfFireRange or 10
            local primeRange = AutoSteal.Radius or 61
            local waitTimeout = AutoSteal.V2WaitTimeout or 2.0

            local function currentDist()
                local ch = LP.Character
                local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not root or not spawn or not spawn.Parent then return math.huge end
                return (root.Position - spawn.Position).Magnitude
            end

            local function setV2Progress(p)
                v2VisualProgress = math.clamp(p, 0, 1)
                if AutoSteal.ProgressFill then
                    AutoSteal.ProgressFill.Size = UDim2.new(v2VisualProgress, 0, 1, 0)
                end
                if AutoSteal.PctLabel then
                    AutoSteal.PctLabel.Text = math.floor(v2VisualProgress * 100) .. "%"
                end
            end

            -- Phase 1: fire hold callbacks and hold for holdMin
            for _, f in ipairs(data.hold) do
                task.spawn(function() pcall(f) end)
            end
            local holdStart = tick()
            local aborted = false
            while AutoSteal.EnabledV2 and (tick() - holdStart) < holdMin do
                if not prompt.Parent then aborted = true; break end
                if currentDist() > primeRange then aborted = true; break end
                local t = math.clamp((tick() - holdStart) / holdMin, 0, 1)
                setV2Progress(t * holdPercent)
                task.wait()
            end

            if aborted or not AutoSteal.EnabledV2 then
                data.ready = true
                v2IsStealing = false
                AutoSteal.IsStealing = false
                AutoSteal.Waiting = false
                setV2Progress(0)
                if AutoSteal.EnabledV2 and AutoSteal.StatusLabel then
                    AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "V2 READY"
                end
                return
            end

            -- Phase 2: FTX V3 style — park at holdPercent, wait for close range, fire
            AutoSteal.Waiting = true
            if AutoSteal.StatusLabel then AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "V2 WAIT" end
            local fired = false

            while AutoSteal.EnabledV2 and prompt.Parent do
                if currentDist() > primeRange then break end

                setV2Progress(holdPercent)
                local waitStart = tick()
                while AutoSteal.EnabledV2 and prompt.Parent and (tick() - waitStart) < waitTimeout do
                    local d = currentDist()
                    if d > primeRange then break end
                    if d <= fireRange then
                        pcall(function()
                            for _, f in ipairs(data.trigger) do
                                task.spawn(function() pcall(f) end)
                            end
                            local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                            local remote = rs:FindFirstChild("StealAnimal")
                            if remote and podName then
                                pcall(function() remote:FireServer(podName) end)
                            end
                            if prompt and prompt.Fire then
                                pcall(function() prompt:Fire() end)
                            end
                        end)
                        fired = true
                        setV2Progress(1)
                        if AutoSteal.StatusLabel then AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "V2 FIRED" end
                        break
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end

                if fired then break end
                -- timeout: briefly reset then re-park at holdPercent (FTX V3 behavior)
                setV2Progress(0)
                task.wait(0.05)
            end

            if fired then
                task.wait(0.15)
            end
            setV2Progress(0)
            data.ready = true
            v2IsStealing = false
            AutoSteal.IsStealing = false
            AutoSteal.Waiting = false
            if AutoSteal.EnabledV2 and AutoSteal.StatusLabel then
                AutoSteal.StatusLabel.Text = "V2 READY"
            end
            task.wait(0.08)
        end)
    end)
end

end

	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do table.insert(accConns,p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) task.wait(0.5); if State.removeAccEnabled then removeAccsFromChar(char) end end)) end
end

function stopHardHit() if _hardHitConn then _hardHitConn:Disconnect(); _hardHitConn=nil end; hideHardHitRing() end

local _antiLagDescConn=nil
function applyAntiLag(ultra)
	local L=game:GetService("Lighting"); L.GlobalShadows=false; L.FogEnd=1e10; L.Brightness=1; L.EnvironmentDiffuseScale=0; L.EnvironmentSpecularScale=0
	for _,e in pairs(L:GetChildren()) do pcall(function() if e:IsA("BlurEffect") or e:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or e:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or e:IsA("BloomEffect") or e:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then e.Enabled=false end end) end
	for _,obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do pcall(function()
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then obj.Material=Enum.Material.Plastic; obj.Reflectance=0; if ultra then obj.CastShadow=false end
		elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then if ultra then obj:Destroy() else obj.Transparency=1 end
		elseif ultra and (obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam") or obj:IsA("Fire")) then obj.Enabled=false end
	end) end
	if ultra then pcall(function() if setfpscap then setfpscap(999999999) end end) end
end
function enableAntiLag()
	State.antiLagEnabled=true; applyAntiLag(false)
	if _antiLagDescConn then _antiLagDescConn:Disconnect() end
	_antiLagDescConn=workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
		if not State.antiLagEnabled then return end
		pcall(function() if obj:IsA("BasePart") then obj.Material=Enum.Material.Plastic; obj.Reflectance=0 elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then obj.Transparency=1 end end)
	end)
end
function disableAntiLag() State.antiLagEnabled=false; if _antiLagDescConn then _antiLagDescConn:Disconnect(); _antiLagDescConn=nil end end
function enableUltraMode() State.ultraModeEnabled=true; applyAntiLag(true) end
function disableUltraMode() State.ultraModeEnabled=false end

local _espObjects={}; local _espReady=false; local _espESPEnabled=false; local _espTracerEnabled=false
function createESPForPlayer(player)
	local data={}; local lines={}
	for i=1,4 do local l=Drawing.new("Line"); l.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147); l.Thickness=1.5; l.Transparency=1; l.Visible=false; lines[i]=l end
	local healthBG=Drawing.new("Line"); healthBG.Color=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0); healthBG.Thickness=4; healthBG.Transparency=1; healthBG.Visible=false
	local healthFG=Drawing.new("Line"); healthFG.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147); healthFG.Thickness=2.5; healthFG.Transparency=1; healthFG.Visible=false
	local distText=Drawing.new("Text"); distText.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147); distText.Size=11; distText.Center=false; distText.Outline=true; distText.Font=Drawing.Fonts.Plex; distText.Visible=false
	local tracer=Drawing.new("Line"); tracer.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147); tracer.Thickness=1.5; tracer.Transparency=1; tracer.Visible=false
	data.Lines=lines; data.HealthBG=healthBG; data.HealthFG=healthFG; data.DistText=distText; data.TracerLine=tracer; data.Player=player; return data
end
function removeESPPlayer(player)
	if not _espObjects[player] then return end; local d=_espObjects[player]; if type(d)~="table" then _espObjects[player]=nil; return end
	for _,l in pairs(d.Lines) do pcall(function() l:Remove() end) end
	pcall(function() d.HealthBG:Remove() end); pcall(function() d.HealthFG:Remove() end); pcall(function() d.DistText:Remove() end); pcall(function() d.TracerLine:Remove() end); _espObjects[player]=nil
end
function addESPPlayer(player)
	if player==LP then return end
	if _espReady then if not _espObjects[player] or type(_espObjects[player])~="table" then _espObjects[player]=createESPForPlayer(player) end else _espObjects[player]=true end
end
function initESP()
	local timeout=tick()+10; repeat task.wait(0.1) until pcall(function() local t=Drawing.new("Line"); t:Remove() end) or tick()>timeout
	if tick()>timeout then return end; _espReady=true
	for player,val in pairs(_espObjects) do if player~=LP and (val==true or type(val)~="table") then _espObjects[player]=createESPForPlayer(player) end end
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not(_espESPEnabled or _espTracerEnabled) then
			for _,data in pairs(_espObjects) do if type(data)=="table" then for _,l in pairs(data.Lines) do l.Visible=false end; data.HealthBG.Visible=false; data.HealthFG.Visible=false; data.DistText.Visible=false; data.TracerLine.Visible=false end end; return
		end
		local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera; if not cam then return end; local vp=cam.ViewportSize
		for player,data in pairs(_espObjects) do
			if type(data)=="table" then
			local char=player.Character; local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local head2=char and char:FindFirstChild("Head"); local humanoid=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); local alive=root and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0
			if alive then
				local _,onScreen=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
				local function getBBox() if not head2 then return nil end; local topW=Vector3.new(root.Position.X,head2.Position.Y+0.5,root.Position.Z); local botW=Vector3.new(root.Position.X,root.Position.Y-3,root.Position.Z); local ts,ton=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(topW); local bs,bon=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(botW); if not ton and not bon then return nil end; local height=math.abs(ts.Y-bs.Y); local width=height*0.5; local cx=ts.X; return {tl=Vector2.new(cx-width/2,ts.Y),tr=Vector2.new(cx+width/2,ts.Y),bl=Vector2.new(cx-width/2,bs.Y),br=Vector2.new(cx+width/2,bs.Y),cx=cx,top=ts.Y,bottom=bs.Y,left=cx-width/2,right=cx+width/2,height=height} end
				local box=getBBox()
				if _espESPEnabled and box and onScreen then
					local L=data.Lines; local col=Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147)
					L[1].From=box.tl; L[1].To=box.tr; L[1].Visible=true; L[1].Color=col
					L[2].From=box.bl; L[2].To=box.br; L[2].Visible=true; L[2].Color=col
					L[3].From=box.tl; L[3].To=box.bl; L[3].Visible=true; L[3].Color=col
					L[4].From=box.tr; L[4].To=box.br; L[4].Visible=true; L[4].Color=col
					local hpPct=math.clamp(humanoid.Health/humanoid.MaxHealth,0,1); local barX=box.left-6
					data.HealthBG.From=Vector2.new(barX,box.top); data.HealthBG.To=Vector2.new(barX,box.bottom); data.HealthBG.Visible=true
					local filledY=box.bottom-(box.height*hpPct); data.HealthFG.From=Vector2.new(barX,filledY); data.HealthFG.To=Vector2.new(barX,box.bottom); data.HealthFG.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147); data.HealthFG.Visible=true
					local dist2=math.floor((cam.CFrame.Position-root.Position).Magnitude); data.DistText.Position=Vector2.new(box.right+5,box.top+(box.height/2)-6); data.DistText.Text=dist2.."m"; data.DistText.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147); data.DistText.Visible=true
				else for _,l in pairs(data.Lines) do l.Visible=false end; data.HealthBG.Visible=false; data.HealthFG.Visible=false; data.DistText.Visible=false end
				if _espTracerEnabled and onScreen then local sp2,_=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position); data.TracerLine.From=Vector2.new(vp.X/2,vp.Y); data.TracerLine.To=Vector2.new(sp2.X,sp2.Y); data.TracerLine.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 147); data.TracerLine.Visible=true
				else data.TracerLine.Visible=false end
			else
				for _,l in pairs(data.Lines or {}) do l.Visible=false end
				if data.HealthBG then data.HealthBG.Visible=false end; if data.HealthFG then data.HealthFG.Visible=false end
				if data.DistText then data.DistText.Visible=false end; if data.TracerLine then data.TracerLine.Visible=false end
			end
			end
		end
	end)
end
for _,p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do addESPPlayer(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(addESPPlayer); Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removeESPPlayer)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5); addESPPlayer(p) end) end)
for _,p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5); addESPPlayer(p) end) end
task.spawn(initESP)
function setESPEnabled(v) _espESPEnabled=v; State.espEnabled=v end
function setTracerEnabled(v) _espTracerEnabled=v; State.tracerEnabled=v end

local _noCamConn=nil; local _noCamParts={}
function enableNoCamCollision()
	State.noCamCollisionEnabled=true
	if _noCamConn then _noCamConn:Disconnect() end
	_noCamConn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not State.noCamCollisionEnabled then return end
		local ch=LP.Character; if not ch then return end; local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera; if not cam then return end
		local hrp2=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not hrp2 then return end
		local camPos=cam.CFrame.Position; local charPos=hrp2.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0)
		local toChar=charPos-camPos; local dist=toChar.Magnitude; if dist<0.3 then return end
		local params=RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude; params.FilterDescendantsInstances={ch}; params.IgnoreWater=true
		local hit={}; local origin=camPos; local remaining=toChar
		for _=1,12 do
			if remaining.Magnitude<0.2 then break end
			local res=workspace:Raycast(origin,remaining,params); if not res then break end
			local p=res.Instance
			if p and p:IsA("BasePart") and not p:IsDescendantOf(ch) then
				hit[p]=true; if _noCamParts[p]==nil then _noCamParts[p]=p.LocalTransparencyModifier end; p.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
			end
			origin=res.Position+remaining.Unit*0.02; remaining=charPos-origin
		end
		for p,orig in pairs(_noCamParts) do if not hit[p] then pcall(function() if p and p.Parent then p.LocalTransparencyModifier=orig end end); _noCamParts[p]=nil end end
	end)
end
function disableNoCamCollision()
	State.noCamCollisionEnabled=false; if _noCamConn then _noCamConn:Disconnect(); _noCamConn=nil end
	for p,orig in pairs(_noCamParts) do pcall(function() if p and p.Parent then p.LocalTransparencyModifier=orig end end) end; _noCamParts={}
end

function u2t(u) return {xs=u.X.Scale,xo=u.X.Offset,ys=u.Y.Scale,yo=u.Y.Offset} end
function t2u(t) if not t then return nil end; return UDim2.new(t.xs or 0,t.xo or 0,t.ys or 0,t.yo or 0) end

local saveDebounce=false
-- Saved mobile layout (positions) only written by saveMobileLayout / Save button
local _savedMobileBtns = nil

function saveMobileLayout()
	local mobileBtns = {}
	if _mbBtnRefs then
		for i, btn in ipairs(_mbBtnRefs) do
			if btn then mobileBtns[tostring(i)] = u2t(btn.Position) end
		end
	end
	_savedMobileBtns = mobileBtns
	return mobileBtns
end

function autoSaveConfig(includeMobilePositions)
	if saveDebounce then return end; saveDebounce=true
	task.delay(0.5,function()
		local pos={}
		if _mainFrame then pos.main=u2t(_mainFrame.Position) end
		if _miniFrame then pos.mini=u2t(_miniFrame.Position) end
		if _comboFrame then pos.combo=u2t(_comboFrame.Position) end
		-- Mobile button positions: only when user pressed Save
		if includeMobilePositions then
			pos.mobileBtns = saveMobileLayout()
		elseif _savedMobileBtns then
			pos.mobileBtns = _savedMobileBtns
		elseif type(_loadedConfig)=="table" and type(_loadedConfig.positions)=="table" and _loadedConfig.positions.mobileBtns then
			pos.mobileBtns = _loadedConfig.positions.mobileBtns
		end
		local panelsSave={}; for _,p in ipairs(UserPanels) do table.insert(panelsSave,{name=p.name,code=p.code}) end
		local gpSave={}; for k,v in pairs(GPKeys) do gpSave[k]=v.Name end
		local cfg={
			normalSpeed=State.normalSpeed,carrySpeed=State.carrySpeed,laggerSpeed=State.laggerSpeed,laggerCarrySpeed=State.laggerCarrySpeed,
			speedType=State.speedType,laggerActive=State.laggerActive,
			autoBatKey=Keys.autoBat.Name,speedKey=Keys.speed.Name,laggerKey=Keys.lagger.Name,
			autoStealEnabled=AutoSteal.Enabled,autoStealV2Enabled=AutoSteal.EnabledV2,grabRadius=AutoSteal.Radius,stealDuration=AutoSteal.Duration,
			autoSwitchSpeed=State.autoSwitchSpeed,
			halfFireRange=AutoSteal.HalfFireRange,halfHoldMax=AutoSteal.HalfHoldMax,halfEntryDelay=AutoSteal.HalfEntryDelay,
			infJump=State.infJumpEnabled,infJumpMode=State.infJumpMode,antiRagdoll=State.antiRagdollEnabled,antiDie=State.antiDieEnabled,fpsBoost=State.fpsBoostEnabled,
			medusaCounter=State.medusaCounterEnabled,dropBrainrotKey=Keys.dropBrainrot.Name,
			autoPlayKey=Keys.autoPlay.Name,guiHideKey=Keys.guiHide.Name,
			animEnabled=State.animEnabled,unwalkEnabled=State.unwalkEnabled,tpDownKey=Keys.tpDown.Name,
			hitboxEnabled=State.hitboxEnabled,darkModeEnabled=State.darkModeEnabled,removeAccEnabled=State.removeAccEnabled,
			menuScale=State.menuScale,autoPlaySide=State.autoPlaySide,
			aimbotSpeed=State.aimbotSpeed,autoSwingEnabled=State.autoSwingEnabled,
			panels=panelsSave,positions=pos,lang=LANG,
			autoTPDownEnabled=State.autoTPDownEnabled,jumpThreshold=State.jumpThreshold,
			hardHitEnabled=State.hardHitEnabled,hardHitRadius=State.hardHitRadius,batRadius=State.batRadius,
			antiLagEnabled=State.antiLagEnabled,ultraModeEnabled=State.ultraModeEnabled,
			espEnabled=State.espEnabled,tracerEnabled=State.tracerEnabled,noCamCollisionEnabled=State.noCamCollisionEnabled,
			gpKeys=gpSave,
			aimBypassToggled=State.aimBypassToggled,antiTpDownToggled=State.antiTpDownToggled,antiTpDownSpeed=State.antiTpDownSpeed,
		
		-- NEW: Save mobile button scale
		mobileBtnScale=State.mobileBtnScale,
		mobileBtnSquare=State.mobileBtnSquare,
		mobileBtnBox=State.mobileBtnBox,
		}
		pcall(function() if writefile then writefile(SAVE_FILE,HttpService:JSONEncode(cfg)) end end); saveDebounce=false
	end)
end

function refreshUIToggles()
	if setSpeedToggleUI then setSpeedToggleUI(State.speedType=="carry") end
	if setLaggerToggleUI then setLaggerToggleUI(State.laggerActive) end
	if modeValLbl then if State.laggerActive then modeValLbl.Text=(State.speedType=="normal") and T("lagger_normal_lbl") or T("lagger_carry_lbl") else modeValLbl.Text=(State.speedType=="normal") and T("normal") or T("carry") end end
end
function toggleSpeedType()
	State.speedType=(State.speedType=="normal") and "carry" or "normal"
	if _G.KSC_DUEL_SpeedConfig then
		_G.KSC_DUEL_SpeedConfig.carry = (State.speedType == "carry")
	end
	refreshUIToggles(); autoSaveConfig()
end
function toggleLagger()
	State.laggerActive = not State.laggerActive
	if _G.KSC_DUEL_SpeedConfig then
		_G.KSC_DUEL_SpeedConfig.family = State.laggerActive and "lagger" or "normal"
		_G.KSC_DUEL_SpeedConfig.carry = (State.speedType == "carry")
	end
	refreshUIToggles()
	autoSaveConfig()
end
function getCurrentSpeed()
	if type(_G.KSC_DUEL_GetSpeed) == "function" then
		return _G.KSC_DUEL_GetSpeed()
	end
	if State.laggerActive then return State.speedType=="normal" and State.laggerSpeed or State.laggerCarrySpeed
	else return State.speedType=="normal" and State.normalSpeed or State.carrySpeed end
end
function getAutoMoveSpeed() return State.laggerActive and State.laggerSpeed or State.normalSpeed end


-- Reliable TP Down (works every press)
local _tpDownBusy = false
function tpToGround()
	if _tpDownBusy then return end
	local char = LP.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root then return end

	_tpDownBusy = true

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local rp = RaycastParams.new()
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
		rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		rp.IgnoreWater = false

		local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -5000, 0), rp)

		-- Fallback: cast from higher if nothing under feet
		if not hit then
			hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 50, 0), Vector3.new(0, -8000, 0), rp)
		end

		if hit then
			local hip = (hum and hum.HipHeight) or 2
			local off = hip + (root.Size.Y * 0.5)
			local targetY = hit.Position.Y + off
			local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
			root.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(root.Position.X, targetY, root.Position.Z), Vector3.new(root.Position.X, targetY, root.Position.Z) + Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z))
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			pcall(function()
				root.Velocity = Vector3.zero
				root.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end)
			if hum then
				pcall(function()
					hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landing)
					hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
				end)
			end
		else
			-- last resort: drop hard downward
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -250, 0)
		end
	end)

	if not ok then
		warn("[KSC_DUEL] tpToGround error:", err)
	end

	-- short cooldown so spam presses still work, but no re-entry race
	task.delay(0.05, function()
		_tpDownBusy = false
	end)
end

local _jumpConn = nil
function startAutoTPDown()
	State.autoTPDownEnabled = true
	if _jumpConn then _jumpConn:Disconnect(); _jumpConn = nil end
	State.jumpCounter = 0
	_jumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
		if not State.autoTPDownEnabled then return end
		State.jumpCounter = State.jumpCounter + 1
		if State.jumpCounter >= (State.jumpThreshold or 2) then
			State.jumpCounter = 0
			task.delay(0.1, function() tpToGround() end)
		end
	end)
end
function stopAutoTPDown()
	State.autoTPDownEnabled = false
	if _jumpConn then _jumpConn:Disconnect(); _jumpConn = nil end
	State.jumpCounter = 0
end

function runDropBrainrot()
	-- MANUAL ONLY (button / keybind H) — full drop with ascend then land
	if State.dropBrainrotActive then return end
	local char = LP.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root then return end
	State.dropBrainrotActive = true

	-- Pause ANTI DROP briefly so drop works, then restore
	local _hadAntiDrop = false
	pcall(function()
		if type(_G.KSC_DUEL_IsAntiDropOn) == "function" and _G.KSC_DUEL_IsAntiDropOn() then
			_hadAntiDrop = true
			if type(_G.KSC_DUEL_StopAntiDrop) == "function" then _G.KSC_DUEL_StopAntiDrop() end
		end
	end)

	-- ===== إسقاط البرينروت فعلياً =====
	pcall(function()
		-- 1) فك أي Tool مش بات/سلاف
		for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
			if tool:IsA("Tool") then
				local n = tool.Name:lower()
				if not (n:find("bat") or n:find("slap")) then
					pcall(function()
						if hum then hum:UnequipTools() end
					end)
					pcall(function() tool.Parent = workspace end)
					pcall(function()
						local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
						if bp then tool.Parent = bp end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		-- 2) موديلات/فولدرات محمولة
		for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder") then
				local n = child.Name:lower()
				if n:find("brain") or n:find("animal") or n:find("pet") or n:find("carry") or n:find("steal") then
					pcall(function() child.Parent = workspace end)
				end
			end
		end
		-- 3) فك لحامات الحمل
		for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if obj:IsA("Weld") or obj:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
				local n = (obj.Name or ""):lower()
				if n:find("carry") or n:find("brain") or n:find("animal") or n:find("grab") or n:find("hold") or n:find("attach") then
					pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
				end
			end
		end
		-- 4) ريموتات دروب شائعة في Steal a Brainrot
		local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		local names = {
			"Drop","DropItem","DropBrainrot","DropAnimal","Unequip","Release","Throw",
			"DropPet","DropCarry","ForceDrop","PlayerDrop"
		}
		for _, n in ipairs(names) do
			local r = rs:FindFirstChild(n, true)
			if r then
				if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
					pcall(function() r:FireServer() end)
					pcall(function() r:FireServer("Drop") end)
					pcall(function() r:FireServer(true) end)
				elseif r:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
					pcall(function() r:InvokeServer() end)
				end
			end
		end
		-- Packages / Net folders
		for _, folderName in ipairs({"Packages","Net","Remotes","Events","Network"}) do
			local folder = rs:FindFirstChild(folderName)
			if folder then
				for _, r in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
					if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
						local ln = r.Name:lower()
						if ln:find("drop") or ln:find("unequip") or ln:find("release") then
							pcall(function() r:FireServer() end)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	-- 5) صعود سريع ثم نزول للأرض (ضروري عشان الدروب يشتغل)
	local t0 = tick()
	local dur = (type(DROP_ASCEND_DURATION) == "number" and DROP_ASCEND_DURATION) or 0.2
	local spd = (type(DROP_ASCEND_SPEED) == "number" and DROP_ASCEND_SPEED) or 150
	local dc
	dc = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local r = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not r then
			if dc then dc:Disconnect() end
			State.dropBrainrotActive = false
			if _hadAntiDrop then
				task.defer(function()
					pcall(function()
						if type(_G.KSC_DUEL_StartAntiDrop) == "function" then _G.KSC_DUEL_StartAntiDrop() end
					end)
				end)
			end
			return
		end
		if tick() - t0 >= dur then
			if dc then dc:Disconnect() end
			local rp = RaycastParams.new()
			rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
			rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			local rr = workspace:Raycast(r.Position, Vector3.new(0, -2000, 0), rp)
			if rr then
				local hum2 = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local off = (hum2 and hum2.HipHeight or 2) + (r.Size.Y / 2)
				r.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.Position.X, rr.Position.Y + off, r.Position.Z)
				r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				pcall(function() r.Velocity = Vector3.zero end)
			end
			State.dropBrainrotActive = false
			if _hadAntiDrop then
				task.defer(function()
					pcall(function()
						if type(_G.KSC_DUEL_StartAntiDrop) == "function" then _G.KSC_DUEL_StartAntiDrop() end
					end)
				end)
			end
			return
		end
		r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, spd, 0)
		pcall(function() r.Velocity = Vector3.new(r.Velocity.X, spd, r.Velocity.Z) end)
	end)
end

local Anims={idle1="rbxassetid://133806214992291",idle2="rbxassetid://94970088341563",walk="rbxassetid://707897309",run="rbxassetid://707861613",jump="rbxassetid://116936326516985",fall="rbxassetid://116936326516985",climb="rbxassetid://116936326516985",swim="rbxassetid://116936326516985",swimidle="rbxassetid://116936326516985"}

function isPackAnim(id) if not id then return false end; for _,v in pairs(Anims) do if v==id then return true end end; return false end
function saveOriginalAnims(char)
	local animate=char:FindFirstChild("Animate"); if not animate then return end
	local function g(obj) return obj and obj.AnimationId or nil end
	local ids={idle1=g(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation1),idle2=g(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation2),walk=g(animate.walk and animate.walk.WalkAnim),run=g(animate.run and animate.run.RunAnim),jump=g(animate.jump and animate.jump.JumpAnim),fall=g(animate.fall and animate.fall.FallAnim),climb=g(animate.climb and animate.climb.ClimbAnim),swim=g(animate.swim and animate.swim.Swim),swimidle=g(animate.swimidle and animate.swimidle.SwimIdle)}
	if not isPackAnim(ids.walk) then originalAnims=ids end
end
function applyAnimPack(char)
	local animate=char:FindFirstChild("Animate"); if not animate then return end
	local function s(obj,id) if obj then obj.AnimationId=id end end
	s(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation1,Anims.idle1); s(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation2,Anims.idle2); s(animate.walk and animate.walk.WalkAnim,Anims.walk); s(animate.run and animate.run.RunAnim,Anims.run); s(animate.jump and animate.jump.JumpAnim,Anims.jump); s(animate.fall and animate.fall.FallAnim,Anims.fall); s(animate.climb and animate.climb.ClimbAnim,Anims.climb); s(animate.swim and animate.swim.Swim,Anims.swim); s(animate.swimidle and animate.swimidle.SwimIdle,Anims.swimidle)
end
function restoreOriginalAnims(char)
	if not originalAnims then return end; local animate=char:FindFirstChild("Animate"); if not animate then return end
	local function s(obj,id) if obj and id then obj.AnimationId=id end end
	s(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation1,originalAnims.idle1); s(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation2,originalAnims.idle2); s(animate.walk and animate.walk.WalkAnim,originalAnims.walk); s(animate.run and animate.run.RunAnim,originalAnims.run); s(animate.jump and animate.jump.JumpAnim,originalAnims.jump); s(animate.fall and animate.fall.FallAnim,originalAnims.fall); s(animate.climb and animate.climb.ClimbAnim,originalAnims.climb); s(animate.swim and animate.swim.Swim,originalAnims.swim); s(animate.swimidle and animate.swimidle.SwimIdle,originalAnims.swimidle)
	local hum2=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if hum2 then for _,track in ipairs(hum2:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do track:Stop(0) end; hum2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end
end

	if char then saveOriginalAnims(char); applyAnimPack(char); local hum2=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if hum2 then for _,track in ipairs(hum2:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do track:Stop(0) end; hum2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end end
	local _animLast=0; animHeartbeatConn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() if not State.animEnabled then return end; local n=tick(); if n-_animLast<0.35 then return end; _animLast=n; local c=LP.Character; if c then applyAnimPack(c) end end)
end

local HitboxData={}; local hitboxConn=nil
function removeHitbox(player) if HitboxData[player] then pcall(function() if HitboxData[player].box and HitboxData[player].box.Parent then HitboxData[player].box:Destroy() end; if HitboxData[player].bb and HitboxData[player].bb.Parent then HitboxData[player].bb:Destroy() end end); HitboxData[player]=nil end end
function createHitboxForPlayer(player)
	if player==LP then return end; removeHitbox(player); local char=player.Character; if not char then return end; local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not root then return end
	local box=Instance.new("SelectionBox"); box.Name="KSC_DUELHitbox"; box.Adornee=root; box.Color3=C_ACCENT; box.LineThickness=0.05; box.SurfaceTransparency=0.85; box.SurfaceColor3=C_ACCENT; box.Parent=workspace
	local head=char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui"); bb.Name="KSC_DUELDistLabel"; bb.Size=UDim2.new(0,120,0,30); bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,2.5,0); bb.AlwaysOnTop=true; bb.Adornee=head or root; bb.Parent=workspace
	local distLbl=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb); distLbl.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); distLbl.BackgroundTransparency=1; distLbl.Text="0m"; distLbl.TextColor3=C_TEXT; distLbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack; distLbl.TextSize=13; distLbl.TextStrokeTransparency=0; distLbl.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	HitboxData[player]={box=box,bb=bb,distLbl=distLbl,char=char}
end
function startHitboxes()
	if hitboxConn then return end
	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p~=LP then createHitboxForPlayer(p) end end
	hitboxConn=Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) if p==LP then return end; p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5); if State.hitboxEnabled then createHitboxForPlayer(p) end end); task.wait(0.5); if State.hitboxEnabled then createHitboxForPlayer(p) end end)
	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p~=LP then p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5); if State.hitboxEnabled then createHitboxForPlayer(p) end end) end end
end
function stopHitboxes() if hitboxConn then hitboxConn:Disconnect(); hitboxConn=nil end; for p,_ in pairs(HitboxData) do removeHitbox(p) end; HitboxData={} end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not State.hitboxEnabled then return end
	local myChar=LP.Character; local myRoot=myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not myRoot then return end
	for player,data in pairs(HitboxData) do pcall(function()
		if not player.Character then removeHitbox(player); return end
		local theirRoot=player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not theirRoot then return end
		if not data.box or not data.box.Parent then createHitboxForPlayer(player); return end
		local dist=math.floor((myRoot.Position-theirRoot.Position).Magnitude); if data.distLbl then data.distLbl.Text=dist.."m" end
	end) end
end)
